66311.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見多顆中等大小的母細胞，核質比極高、只有一圈很薄的藍色細胞質、染色質細緻、核仁不明顯，部分核有凹陷或切跡，且無顆粒與 Auer 小體，形態符合淋巴母細胞（lymphoblast）。
features: Five medium-sized blasts, roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented/clefted nuclei with finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells show prominent central pallor (hypochromia) with mild anisocytosis
Platelets are sparse in this field
66311.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating blasts on a background of red cells with conspicuous central pallor and mild anisocytosis; platelets appear reduced. The blasts are medium-sized with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods, cytoplasmic granules, or dysplastic neutrophils are identified in this field. Morphology is consistent with lymphoblasts; in conjunction with the reported CD10/CD19/cCD79a-positive immunophenotype, findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable from B-lymphoblasts; separation requires flow cytometry showing cytoplasmic CD3 without B-lineage markers, often with a mediastinal mass.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation (M0)
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may also be agranular, but they are MPO/myeloid-marker positive (CD13, CD33, CD117) and lack CD19/CD10/cCD79a.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mantle cell lymphoma (blastoid)
ddx.vs: Occurs in older adults, cells are CD5+/cyclin D1+ mature B cells with surface light chain and lack TdT/CD34, unlike precursor B lymphoblasts.
Reactive lymphocytes show mature clumped chromatin, more abundant cytoplasm, and a heterogeneous population rather than a monotonous blast population with fine chromatin.

66375.recognize_zh: GMS 銀染的骨髓切片中，綠色背景下多處可見黑色、成團的小圓形至橢圓形酵母體聚集在組織球細胞質內，另有少數散在；在骨髓中看到這種細胞內成群的 GMS 陽性小酵母，支持組織漿菌侵犯。
features: Multiple discrete clusters of small, uniform, black GMS-positive round-to-oval yeasts within histiocyte cytoplasm
Occasional scattered single extracellular silver-positive forms
Yeasts appear small (roughly 2-4 um); budding cannot be reliably resolved at this magnification
Light green counterstained cellular marrow with preserved hematopoietic cells and numerous adipocyte spaces
No hyphae or large capsulated forms seen
66375.describe_en: GMS-stained bone marrow trephine section shows cellular marrow with numerous adipocyte spaces against a light green counterstain. Multiple discrete aggregates of small, uniform, black-staining round-to-oval yeast forms are present within the cytoplasm of scattered histiocytes, with occasional single extracellular forms. No hyphae, pseudohyphae, or large capsulated yeasts are identified, and budding is not well resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by small intracellular yeasts, supporting disseminated Histoplasma capsulatum infection in the appropriate clinical and culture context.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes do not stain with GMS, so silver-positive intracellular organisms exclude it.
Also GMS-positive, but shows elongated sausage-shaped forms with a central transverse septum instead of oval budding yeasts.
Cryptococcal yeasts are larger and more variable (4-10 um) with a mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular, cup- or helmet-shaped, and often show a central dot, rather than clustered intracellular oval yeasts.

66119.recognize_zh: 左側一群白血球（嗜中性球與單核球）胞質內有金黃色、具折光性的細長棒狀或針狀結晶，顏色並非染料的紫色；背景紅血球鋸齒狀並布滿環狀乾燥假影，符合高膽紅素血症下白血球內的膽紅素結晶。
features: Several leukocytes with golden-yellow, refractile, rod- to needle-shaped cytoplasmic crystals, some clustered over the nucleus
Affected cells include a neutrophil with lobulated nucleus and cells with larger folded nuclei (monocytes)
Crystals retain intrinsic yellow color and do not take up Romanowsky stain
Background crenated red cells with abundant dark-rimmed refractile drying artifacts
66119.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows crenated red cells with prominent refractile drying artifact. A cluster of leukocytes, including neutrophils and monocytes, contains golden-yellow, refractile, rod- and needle-shaped intracytoplasmic crystals; one leukocyte at the upper right lacks crystals. The crystals are distinguished from background artifact by their yellow color and intracellular location. Findings are consistent with bilirubin crystals within neutrophils and monocytes, associated with marked hyperbilirubinemia.

ddx.vs: Drying artifact appears as dark-rimmed colorless rings over red cells and background, whereas bilirubin crystals are yellow and confined to leukocytes.
Hemosiderin is granular golden-brown to blue-black and Prussian blue-positive, unlike bright yellow iron-negative needle-shaped crystals.
Hemozoin is brown-black granular pigment with parasitized red cells present, not bright yellow rods.

66055.recognize_zh: 低倍下紅血球聚成大小不一、形狀不規則的三維團塊，細胞之間彼此重疊交錯，而非像錢串（rouleaux）般線狀排列；團塊之間散在單顆紅血球，白血球與血小板正常，符合冷凝集素造成的紅血球凝集。
features: Extensive red cell agglutination forming large, irregular, three-dimensional clumps throughout the field
Clumps are haphazard and grape-like rather than linear coin-stack rouleaux
Intervening single red cells, some appearing small and rounded
Three segmented neutrophils and scattered platelets without clumping
Background plasma clear, without increased blue proteinaceous staining
66055.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows extensive red cell agglutination with large, irregular, haphazard clumps of erythrocytes distributed throughout the field, separated by single red cells. The aggregates lack the linear coin-stack arrangement of rouleaux. Scattered segmented neutrophils and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination due to a cold agglutinin; warming the specimen to 37 °C should disperse the clumps, and a direct antiglobulin test (C3d-positive) and cold agglutinin titer are recommended.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear stacks of red cells resembling coins, often with a bluish background, and disperse with saline, whereas agglutinates are irregular three-dimensional clumps.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with IgG-positive DAT, and agglutination is usually absent or minimal and not temperature-dependent.
Overlapping cells in a thick area are uniformly crowded, whereas agglutinates form discrete clumps separated by clear spaces in a thin area.

65863.recognize_zh: 視野中三顆嗜中性球都只有兩葉或分葉不完全：中下方兩顆為兩個粗塊狀核葉上下相疊或以粗橋相連，上方一顆核葉擠成團；染色質明顯凝集、細胞質顆粒正常，符合分葉不足（pseudo-Pelger）嗜中性球。
features: Three neutrophils, all with hyposegmented nuclei (bilobed or incompletely segmented)
Lobes are rounded and stacked or joined by short thick bridges; one nucleus appears as a compact clumped mass
Coarse, condensed mature chromatin
Preserved neutrophilic granulation; no hypogranularity evident
Background red cells with drying artifact and occasional crenated forms; scattered platelets
65863.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils, all with hyposegmented nuclei consisting of two rounded lobes that are stacked or joined by short bridges, with coarsely clumped mature chromatin and normal granulation. Red cells show drying artifact with occasional crenated cells, and platelets are present. The predominance of bilobed neutrophils in one field is consistent with Pelger-Huët-type change; given the reported infection-associated leukocytosis, a reactive pseudo-Pelger-Huët change is favored.

ddx.vs: Cannot be separated morphologically; persistence after infection resolves and family studies favor the inherited LBR-related anomaly.
MDS usually shows hypogranular neutrophils, cytopenias and multilineage dysplasia, which are not evident here.
Morphology is identical; the distinction rests on medication history and resolution after withdrawal.

65799.recognize_zh: 油鏡下許多紅血球內出現單個或成群的小型透亮空泡，大小與數量不一，背景血小板正常、紅血球大小大致一致，配合脾臟切除後病史，符合脾臟無法清除的紅血球空泡（pitted/vacuolated RBC）。
features: Numerous normocytic red cells containing small, clear, round vacuoles, single or clustered
Vacuoles vary in size and number from cell to cell
A few red cells show tiny dark punctate dots at the cell margin, of uncertain nature at this resolution (possible precipitate)
No definite Howell-Jolly bodies, parasites or basophilic stippling
Occasional platelets; leukocytes not present in this field
65799.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows normocytic red cells, many of which contain small, clear, round vacuoles that occur singly or in clusters and vary in size and number. Rare tiny dark punctate dots are seen at red cell margins, but their nature cannot be determined at this resolution and definite Howell-Jolly bodies or parasites are not identified. Platelets are present. In the post-splenectomy setting, findings are compatible with nonspecific red cell vacuoles/pits; drying artifact should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Artifactual refractile spots vary with fine focus and smear region, while true vacuoles persist in well-dried areas.
Ring forms have a blue cytoplasmic ring with a red-purple chromatin dot, unlike empty vacuoles.
Pappenheimer bodies are small basophilic granules confirmed by Prussian blue staining, not clear spaces.

65735.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片有兩群細胞：大量染色質粗塊狀的小型成熟淋巴球（紅箭頭）與較大、核仁明顯、胞質藍的母細胞（黃箭頭）；切片 CD20 標出結節狀 B 細胞聚集，CD34 陽性母細胞則散佈在結節之外的間質。
features: Aspirate: numerous small to medium mature lymphocytes with round nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin (red arrow)
Admixed larger blasts with fine chromatin, prominent nucleoli and scant to moderate blue cytoplasm (yellow arrow)
Core biopsy: markedly hypercellular marrow with a lymphoid aggregate of small cells and interstitial immature cells outside it
CD20: large nodular aggregates of B cells occupying much of the cellularity
CD34: increased positive blasts in the interstitium between the CD20+ nodules, which are themselves CD34-negative
65735.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a marked increase in small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin together with an increased population of medium to large blasts with fine chromatin, prominent nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm. The core biopsy is markedly hypercellular (about 90%) with nodular aggregates of small lymphocytes and interstitial clusters of immature cells outside the aggregates. CD20 highlights large nodular B-cell aggregates, and CD34 shows a separate, increased interstitial blast population (roughly 10-20% of cellularity) sparing the lymphoid nodules. Findings are consistent with concurrent chronic lymphocytic leukemia and a high-grade therapy-related myeloid neoplasm (MDS/AML, therapy-related).

ddx.vs: Paraimmunoblasts lie within proliferation centers and are CD20+/CD34-negative, whereas the large cells here are interstitial and CD34+.
Richter shows sheets of large CD20+ B cells, not CD34+ myeloblasts separate from the B-cell nodules.
Hematogones are small with scant cytoplasm and show a maturing CD34/CD10/CD20 continuum on flow rather than CD34+/CD117+/CD33+ myeloblasts.
The CD5+ B-cell nodules and separate monotypic B-cell population on flow establish a coexisting CLL.

65671.recognize_zh: 大腸切片黏膜固有層被多形性淋巴樣細胞瀰漫浸潤：中大型不規則核的非典型 T 細胞夾雜小淋巴球、免疫母細胞、漿細胞樣細胞；雙染顯示 CD25 陽性 T 細胞與 CD79a 陽性、λ 限制的漿細胞樣細胞並存，且 EBER 散在陽性，提示 ATLL 合併 EBV 相關多形性淋巴增生。
features: Endoscopy: pale, edematous colonic mucosa with shallow ulceration
Low power: dense diffuse lymphoid infiltrate expanding the lamina propria and separating crypts
Medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours and occasional nucleoli, admixed with small lymphocytes, immunoblasts, plasmacytoid cells and eosinophils
Double IHC: CD25+ (red) atypical cells intermixed with CD79a+ (brown) plasmacytoid cells; kappa/lambda double stain shows lambda predominance
High Ki-67 proliferation index
Focal EBNA2 and LMP1 positivity with numerous EBER-positive nuclei
65671.describe_en: Colonoscopic biopsy shows mucosa diffusely expanded by a polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate that separates and destroys crypts. The infiltrate contains medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei and occasional nucleoli, in a background of small lymphocytes, immunoblasts, plasmacytoid cells and eosinophils. Double immunostains show CD25-positive atypical T cells intermixed with CD79a-positive plasmacytoid cells that are lambda-restricted, a high Ki-67 index, focal EBNA2 and LMP1 expression, and numerous EBER-positive cells. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma involving colon, coexisting with an immune dysregulation-associated EBV-positive polymorphic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with EBV+ bystander B cells
ddx.vs: Lacks HTLV-1 association and CD25 expression pattern of ATLL, and the EBV+ B cells are not clonal lambda-restricted plasmacytoid cells.
Features T follicular helper phenotype (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) with arborizing high endothelial venules and expanded FDC meshworks rather than CD25+ HTLV-1-driven cells.
Shows sheets of monomorphic EBV+ large B cells rather than a polymorphous infiltrate dominated by atypical CD3+/CD25+ T cells.

ddx.dx: Inflammatory bowel disease or CMV colitis
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates lack cytologic atypia, CD7 loss, clonal TRG/IGH rearrangement and EBER-positive cells.

65671.stain: H&E; IHC: CD79a/CD25, κ/λ, Ki67, EBNA2, LMP1; EBER

65287.recognize_zh: 中央大細胞有深藍色細胞質、核旁淡染區（Golgi 區），核染色質呈細顆粒篩網狀、未見凝集，右上另一顆同型細胞可見核仁；背景紅血球大小不一並有淚滴形，符合巨母紅血球性貧血中的前紅血球母細胞（megaloblastic proerythroblast）。
features: Large cells (about 3 red cell diameters) with round nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Finely granular, open 'sieve-like' chromatin without condensation; nucleoli visible in the upper-right cell
Pale perinuclear Golgi zone and small cytoplasmic vacuoles in the central cell
Moderate rim of cytoplasm with smooth to slightly bulging borders
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis including teardrop and oval forms
65287.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows large erythroid progenitors among mature red cells. The central cell is a proerythroblast with a round nucleus containing finely stippled, open chromatin, a moderate amount of intensely basophilic cytoplasm, and a pale perinuclear Golgi zone; a second similar cell at upper right shows discernible nucleoli. The cells are larger than normal proerythroblasts, and the background shows anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop and oval forms. In the clinical context of B12/folate deficiency, the findings are consistent with megaloblastic proerythroblasts.

ddx.vs: Normoblastic proerythroblasts are smaller with slightly coarser chromatin, and megaloblastic change is best judged in later stages where nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony becomes obvious.
Myeloblasts have less intensely basophilic cytoplasm, may contain granules or Auer rods, lack the perinuclear hof and cytoplasmic blebs, and are MPO-positive.

ddx.dx: Pure erythroid leukemia / parvovirus giant pronormoblast
ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of vacuolated proerythroblasts with dysplasia, and parvovirus giant pronormoblasts have large glassy nuclear inclusions, whereas megaloblastic anemia shows a full spectrum of asynchronous maturation.

65223.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型腫瘤細胞核偏位、染色質粗、可見核仁、細胞質深藍（漿母細胞樣），旁有吞噬細胞的組織球；切片中大片細胞 MUM1、EBER、HHV-8（LANA）核陽性，流式為 CD38 強陽性、lambda 限制、CD20 陰性、IgM 陽性，符合 HHV-8 陽性 DLBCL 合併 EBV。
features: Large neoplastic cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm (plasmablastic appearance)
Central histiocyte containing phagocytosed nucleated cells (hemophagocytosis)
Core/clot H&E: diffuse sheets of large atypical cells replacing marrow
MUM1, HHV-8 (LANA) and EBV (EBER) show nuclear positivity in a large proportion of cells
Flow cytometry: CD38-bright population, CD45 positive, lambda restricted (96.7%), CD20 negative with partial CD19, surface IgM positive, variable CD27
65223.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of large atypical cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, along with a histiocyte engulfing nucleated cells. The corresponding biopsy shows diffuse sheets of large cells that are positive for MUM1, HHV-8 LANA and EBV (EBER), indicating dual viral infection. Flow cytometry identifies a CD38-bright, CD45-positive, lambda-restricted population lacking CD20 with partial CD19 and IgM expression. Findings are consistent with HHV-8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with EBV coinfection in a posttransplant setting.

ddx.vs: PEL is also HHV-8+ and usually EBV+ but typically lacks surface/cytoplasmic immunoglobulin and is CD45+ with null phenotype, whereas HHV-8+ DLBCL expresses IgM lambda and is often EBV negative; clinical distribution helps.
PBL is EBV positive and CD20 negative but is HHV-8 negative and usually CD138 positive, unlike these HHV-8+ CD138-negative cells.
EBV-positive DLBCL/PTLD lacks HHV-8 LANA nuclear staining, which is the key discriminator here.
Myeloma cells are CD138 and BCMA positive, CD45 often negative, and HHV-8/EBV negative, whereas this population is CD138 and BCMA negative.

65223.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: MUM1, HHV-8; ISH: EBER; flow

65159.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖：CD45 偏弱、SSC 低的異常族群（紅色），CD3、CD5、CD19、CD10、CD20、CD34、CD117、CD13、CD25 皆陰性，但表現 CD7、CD33、HLA-DR 與 CD26；缺乏系列專一標記，須追加 CD123、CD4、CD56 以考慮 BPDCN。
features: Abnormal population (red, gate G) with dim-to-intermediate CD45 and low side scatter
Negative for surface CD3, CD5, CD19, CD10 and CD20 (no T- or B-lineage evidence)
Negative for CD34 and CD117, and CD13-negative
Positive for CD7, CD33 (moderate) and HLA-DR
CD26-positive and CD25-negative (92% CD26+ CD25-)
65159.describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plots (panel 1) show an abnormal population with dim-to-intermediate CD45 and low side scatter. The population lacks CD3, CD5, CD19, CD10, CD20, CD34, CD117, CD13 and CD25, and expresses CD7, CD33, HLA-DR and CD26. This profile lacks lineage-defining markers and could initially be misinterpreted as T-ALL on the basis of CD7 expression, but the absence of CD34 and T-lineage markers should prompt evaluation of CD4, CD56 and CD123. In conjunction with the complementary panel (CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, NG2+), the findings are suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: T-ALL expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and often TdT/CD1a/CD34, whereas this population is surface and cytoplasmic CD3-negative and TdT-negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML can be CD4+/CD56+/CD33+ but usually expresses CD13, CD11b, CD14/CD64 or lysozyme, and lacks bright CD123 with TCF4/TCL1.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia of ambiguous lineage (acute undifferentiated leukemia)
ddx.vs: AUL is a diagnosis of exclusion that requires a negative pDC panel (CD123, TCF4, TCL1, CD303), which was ultimately positive here.

65095.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內散布許多小型濾泡，中心呈粉紅色玻璃樣、細胞稀少的萎縮生發中心，外圍小淋巴球同心圓排列；濾泡間區血管增生並有纖維帶與管壁增厚的血管。
features: Low-power (2x) lymph node with numerous small, evenly distributed follicles
Atrophic, hyalinized pink germinal centers depleted of lymphoid cells
Mantle zones with concentric layering of small lymphocytes around the regressed centers
Hypervascular interfollicular areas with thick-walled, sclerotic vessels and fibrous bands
Preserved nodal architecture without sheets of atypical cells
65095.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows preserved architecture with numerous small follicles containing regressed, hyalinized germinal centers surrounded by concentrically layered mantle lymphocytes. The interfollicular areas are expanded and hypervascular, with thick-walled sclerotic vessels and fibrous bands. No diffuse effacement or atypical infiltrate is appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease-like changes with regressed germinal centers, in keeping with TAFRO-type idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease in the proper clinical context.

ddx.vs: The plasmacytic type has hyperplastic rather than atrophic germinal centers and sheets of interfollicular plasma cells, with less vascular proliferation.
HHV-8 disease shows similar regressed follicles but contains LANA-1-positive lambda-restricted plasmablasts in the mantle zones, typically in HIV-positive patients.
Follicular lymphoma shows crowded, enlarged follicles with attenuated mantles and BCL2-positive neoplastic germinal centers rather than small hyalinized regressed centers.

64903.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 DBA44 免疫染色可見許多細胞呈強烈、顆粒狀的棕色胞質陽性，成群散佈於脂肪之間；其間夾雜核圓、呈藍色對比染色的陰性細胞，陽性細胞即為毛細胞白血病細胞。
features: Strong coarse granular cytoplasmic DBA44 staining in numerous cells
Positive cells distributed interstitially in clusters and small sheets
Admixed DBA44-negative cells with round nuclei and clear counterstained cytoplasm
Adipocytes preserved between the infiltrate
64903.describe_en: DBA44 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow trephine shows strong granular cytoplasmic staining in numerous interstitially distributed cells arranged in clusters and small sheets between adipocytes. Interspersed negative cells with round nuclei are present and likely include the coexisting plasma cell population and residual hematopoietic cells. The staining pattern supports marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia; because DBA44 is not specific, correlation with annexin A1, CD25, CD123, or BRAF V600E is recommended.

ddx.vs: SMZL and other small B-cell lymphomas can also be DBA44 positive, but they are negative for annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: These cells may express DBA44 but lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Plasma cells are CD138 positive and DBA44 negative, consistent with the negative round-nucleated cells in this field.

64519.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成群的漿細胞：細胞核偏心、染色質呈鐘面狀（clock-face）粗塊，細胞質豐富灰藍並有核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），還可見雙核漿細胞，數量明顯增加，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells, singly and in small clusters, larger than normal plasma cells
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face / checkerboard chromatin; some with visible nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Binucleate plasma cell (lower left panel)
Background residual myeloid cells (neutrophils, band forms) and small lymphocytes
64519.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (composite of five fields) shows increased plasma cells present singly and in loose clusters. The plasma cells are medium to large with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clumped (clock-face) chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing; binucleate forms are present. Residual granulocytic precursors and small lymphocytes are seen in the background. A plasma cell percentage should be determined on a 500-cell differential and clonality confirmed by flow cytometry or kappa/lambda staining. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually fewer (<10%), small and mature without binucleation or nucleoli, and are polytypic by kappa/lambda.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD19/CD20+ B cells and MYD88 L265P rather than sheets of pure plasma cells.
Cells are immunoblastic with large central nucleoli and high Ki-67, often EBER+, typically in an extramedullary/immunocompromised setting without a serum M-protein pattern of myeloma.
Monocytic cells have folded nuclei with fine chromatin and grey cytoplasm with fine granules, lacking the eccentric clock-face nucleus and hof.

64455.recognize_zh: 同一視野中可見原始細胞（myeloblast）、骨髓細胞（myelocyte）、帶狀核與分葉中性球，並伴隨多個嗜酸性球與嗜鹼性球，呈現「整條成熟譜系」的顆粒球增生，是慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）周邊血的典型表現。
features: Marked granulocytosis spanning the full maturation spectrum: myeloblasts, myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Myeloblasts (1): large cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Myelocytes (2): round to oval eccentric nuclei with condensed chromatin and granular cytoplasm
Absolute eosinophilia: several eosinophils (3) with coarse orange-red granules
Basophil (4) with dense purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Background red cells largely normocytic without significant dysplastic changes in the neutrophils
64455.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, including occasional myeloblasts, myelocytes, band forms and segmented neutrophils, with a characteristic 'myelocyte bulge' pattern. Eosinophils are increased and a basophil is present. The maturing neutrophils lack significant dysplasia (no hypogranulation or pseudo-Pelger-Huet forms). Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in chronic phase; confirmation by BCR::ABL1 FISH/RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies without absolute basophilia or eosinophilia, and lack BCR::ABL1.
aCML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia (hypogranular, abnormally segmented neutrophils) with minimal basophilia, whereas CML neutrophils are morphologically normal.
CNL consists predominantly of mature segmented neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes and no basophilia.
Blast phase requires ≥20% blasts (or extramedullary blast proliferation), and ≥20% basophils is a high-risk feature, beyond the occasional blasts seen here.

64327.recognize_zh: 中央偏右的巨噬細胞內含一群大小一致的小卵圓形酵母菌（有偏心核點與透明暈），上方另一顆組織球細胞質佈滿空泡並含藍綠色顆粒，背景為造血細胞，符合骨髓內播散性組織胞漿菌症。
features: Macrophage (center right) containing a cluster of small uniform oval yeasts with eccentric nuclear dots and clear halos
Large histiocyte (top center) with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing blue-green granules (possible hemosiderin or degenerated material)
Several large immature-appearing cells with open chromatin and nucleoli, plus erythroid precursors and granulocytes with orange-red granules
Background red cells and fibrin strands; quick stain with brownish cast
64327.describe_en: Rapid-stained bedside smear with marrow cellularity shows a macrophage containing a cluster of small, uniform oval intracellular yeasts with eccentric nuclear staining and surrounding clear halos. An adjacent histiocyte has abundant vacuolated cytoplasm with blue-green granular inclusions, and background cells include erythroid precursors, granulocytic cells and several larger mononuclear cells. Unequivocal hemophagocytosis of intact blood cells is not demonstrated in this field. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis, which may trigger secondary HLH in an immunosuppressed transplant recipient.

ddx.vs: Amastigotes contain a kinetoplast adjacent to the nucleus and lack a halo, distinguishing them from Histoplasma yeasts.
Talaromyces shows transverse septation from binary fission and elongated forms rather than uniform oval budding yeasts.
HLH shows macrophages engulfing red cells, platelets or nucleated cells without microorganisms, whereas here the inclusions are uniform yeasts.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic without halos, and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular and rarely seen in marrow macrophages.

64391.recognize_zh: 周邊血中多顆中到大型異常細胞，核呈摺疊、凹陷或不規則形，細胞質淡灰藍、只含少量極細顆粒，中央還有數顆破碎的細胞留下顆粒狀碎屑，這種低顆粒、核摺疊的細胞群提示微顆粒型 APL（M3v）。
features: Intermediate to large abnormal cells with moderate to high N:C ratio
Irregular, folded, indented or slightly lobulated nuclei with moderately fine chromatin
Pale gray-blue cytoplasm with sparse fine azurophilic granules; one cell with more basophilic cytoplasm
Several disrupted/degenerating cells releasing granular debris in the center of the field
No Auer rods identified; red cells unremarkable and platelets not conspicuous
64391.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous intermediate to large abnormal cells with irregular, folded to indented nuclei, moderately fine chromatin and a moderate amount of pale gray-blue cytoplasm with sparse fine granules. Several disrupted cells with released granular cytoplasmic debris are present centrally. Auer rods are not identified in this field, and platelets are not conspicuous. Findings are suggestive of the microgranular variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; immediate PML::RARA confirmation and assessment for DIC are required.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts have vacuolated gray cytoplasm and nonspecific esterase positivity with weaker MPO, while M3v blasts are strongly MPO-positive and usually HLA-DR/CD34-negative.
Hairy cells have oval nuclei with circumferential hairy projections and no azurophilic granules, and are CD103/CD11c/CD25-positive B cells.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have deeply basophilic, often vacuolated agranular cytoplasm and are MPO-negative.
CLL smudge cells arise from fragile small mature lymphocytes, whereas the intact cells here are large with folded nuclei and granular cytoplasm.

64199.recognize_zh: 視野中四顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞質豐富、淺藍色帶細纖維紋理，小核偏心，外觀似 Gaucher 細胞；背景滿是各階段幼紅血球（紅血球系增生），配合乙型地中海貧血病史，應判為假性 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Several large histiocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm showing fine fibrillary/striated texture
Small, round, eccentric to central nuclei with coarse chromatin
A few cells with small ingested dark nuclear debris (likely phagocytosed erythroid nuclei)
Marked erythroid hyperplasia with abundant basophilic, polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Red cells with anisopoikilocytosis in the background
64199.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular specimen with marked erythroid hyperplasia, including numerous normoblasts at all stages of maturation. Scattered among them are large macrophages with small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue cytoplasm bearing a fine fibrillary, Gaucher-like texture, some containing ingested nuclear debris. Background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis. In a patient with beta thalassemia, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells reflecting increased cell turnover in the setting of ineffective erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: True Gaucher cells are morphologically near-identical on light microscopy, but show reduced glucocerebrosidase activity, GBA1 mutations and tubular inclusions on electron microscopy.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules rather than diffuse fibrillary blue cytoplasm; they may also occur in thalassemia.
MAC-laden histiocytes show negative-image striations and are acid-fast positive, typically in immunocompromised patients.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells of CML or myeloma
ddx.vs: These are morphologically identical, so the association is made from the background marrow: myeloid hyperplasia with basophilia in CML or clonal plasma cells in myeloma rather than erythroid hyperplasia.

64135.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin）中，整片骨髓被瀰漫且密集交織的黑色網狀纖維取代，可見大量交叉點與粗大平行成束的纖維，呈流水狀排列，符合 MF-3（grade 3）骨髓纖維化，見於原發性骨髓纖維化（PMF）纖維化期。
features: Diffuse, dense increase in black reticulin fibers throughout the marrow
Extensive intersections forming a tight meshwork
Coarse, thick fiber bundles in parallel, streaming arrangement
Marrow cells entrapped and distorted between fiber bundles
Red counterstain background; no collagen-specific stain in this image
64135.describe_en: Reticulin stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and coarse, thick bundles arranged in a streaming pattern that entraps residual marrow cells. These findings correspond to grade 3 (MF-3) reticulin fibrosis by the WHO/European consensus grading system. A trichrome stain would help document associated collagen deposition and osteosclerosis. Findings are consistent with advanced fibrosis in the overt fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: MF-2 shows diffuse increase with extensive intersections and focal thick fibers, whereas MF-3 has extensive coarse bundles often with collagen/osteosclerosis as seen here.

ddx.dx: Secondary myelofibrosis (post-PV/ET, metastatic carcinoma, hairy cell leukemia)
ddx.vs: Reticulin grade does not separate these; H&E morphology (tumor cells, megakaryocyte features), IHC, and JAK2/CALR/MPL status are required.
APMF also shows marked fibrosis but has increased CD34-positive blasts (≥20%) and acute presentation without marked splenomegaly.

64007.recognize_zh: 空心箭頭指的紅血球邊緣有一個透明泡狀區（blister cell），實心箭頭指的紅血球邊緣像被咬掉一口（bite cell），背景還有許多皺縮紅血球，符合氧化性溶血的表現。
features: Blister cell (open arrow): red cell with hemoglobin retracted to one side leaving a clear peripheral vacuole
Bite cells (solid arrows): red cells with one or more semicircular peripheral defects, some giving a mushroom-like outline
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes) in the background
Mild anisocytosis; no spherocytes clearly predominant
Scattered platelets; no leukocytes in field
64007.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Leishman stain, high power) shows red cells with poikilocytosis including blister cells, in which hemoglobin is displaced to one side leaving a clear peripheral vacuole, and bite cells with semicircular notches in the cell margin, some producing a mushroom-like contour. Many crenated red cells are present in the background. Schistocytes and spherocytes are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis, as seen in drug-induced hemolytic anemia or G6PD deficiency.

ddx.vs: Identical bite and blister cells occur, so G6PD enzyme assay (repeated after the acute reticulocytosis) is required to distinguish it from oxidant drug injury in normal red cells.
MAHA shows fragmented helmet and triangular schistocytes with thrombocytopenia rather than intact cells with a single rounded bite or hemoglobin-free blister.
Congenital unstable hemoglobins can produce the same Heinz bodies and bite cells, and are identified by isopropanol stability testing, HPLC or globin gene sequencing.
Keratocytes have two horn-like projections around a ruptured vacuole and associate with fragmentation, whereas bite cells show a smooth concave defect without horns.

63815.recognize_zh: 左邊是四格膠囊內視鏡畫面，腸腔內滿是鮮紅血液、看不清黏膜細節；右邊是切除的小腸段肉眼照，黃色環狀皺襞間夾雜暗紅色出血點與血塊；這些圖只能證明小腸出血，血管擴張（angiodysplasia）的確診需靠組織切片，而 von Willebrand 病會讓這類病灶出血更嚴重。
features: Capsule endoscopy frames (four near-identical images) showing a bright red lumen filled with fresh blood and small reflective bubbles, obscuring mucosal detail
Gross photograph of an opened resected small bowel segment with prominent yellow plicae circulares
Dark red to black hemorrhagic foci and adherent blood clots between mucosal folds
No discrete mass, ulcer crater or diverticulum evident at this resolution
Serosal surface visible along one edge with fine vascular pattern; image resolution limited
63815.describe_en: Composite figure. Capsule endoscopy frames show a small bowel lumen filled with fresh blood, which obscures the underlying mucosa. The gross photograph shows an opened segment of small intestine with preserved plicae circulares and multiple dark red hemorrhagic foci and clots on the mucosal surface; no mass lesion is apparent. The images document active small bowel bleeding but cannot by themselves demonstrate the vascular lesion; the reported histology of dilated, congested, irregular thin-walled vascular channels beneath focally eroded mucosa supports intestinal angiodysplasia in a patient with von Willebrand disease.

ddx.dx: Heyde syndrome (acquired von Willebrand syndrome with aortic stenosis)
ddx.vs: Heyde syndrome produces the same angiodysplasia-related bleeding but with loss of high-molecular-weight VWF multimers and aortic stenosis, rather than a lifelong low VWF antigen of inherited type 1 VWD.
A Dieulafoy lesion is a single large-caliber tortuous submucosal artery protruding through a tiny mucosal defect, not a cluster of ectatic mucosal and submucosal capillaries and venules.

ddx.dx: Small bowel neoplasm (GIST, neuroendocrine tumor, lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Neoplasms form a mass or ulcerated lesion on endoscopy, gross examination and histology, which is not seen here.
HHT shows multiple mucocutaneous telangiectasias with epistaxis and a family history and ENG/ACVRL1 mutations, rather than isolated acquired intestinal angiodysplasia.

63751.recognize_zh: 這是頸部電腦斷層（冠狀切面與橫切面），黃色圈起處可見右側頸部多顆腫大、彼此相鄰成串的軟組織密度淋巴結；影像只能顯示淋巴結病變的範圍，何杰金淋巴瘤的診斷需靠切片確認。
features: Contrast-enhanced CT of the neck, coronal (left) and axial (right) images
Multiple enlarged, rounded soft-tissue density lymph nodes in the right cervical chain (yellow circles)
Nodes are conglomerate/matted with thin fat planes and relatively homogeneous attenuation
No obvious central necrosis or calcification appreciable at this resolution
Contralateral side shows smaller nodes; airway midline
63751.describe_en: Coronal and axial contrast-enhanced CT images of the neck show extensive right-sided cervical lymphadenopathy, with multiple enlarged, rounded, relatively homogeneous nodes forming a conglomerate along the jugular chain (circled). There is no obvious central necrosis or calcification at this resolution, and the airway remains midline. Imaging demonstrates the distribution and bulk of nodal disease but is not specific; tissue biopsy is required, and in this case histology and immunohistochemistry established classical Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CT appearance overlaps completely; excisional biopsy with immunohistochemistry is needed to separate them.

ddx.dx: Metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of head and neck
ddx.vs: Metastatic SCC nodes more often show central necrosis and irregular enhancement, and biopsy shows keratin-positive carcinoma.
TB nodes frequently show rim enhancement with central low attenuation and calcification, with granulomas and AFB on biopsy.
Reactive nodes are usually smaller, oval with preserved fatty hilum, and resolve over time without effaced architecture on biopsy.

63687.recognize_zh: 一群彼此黏合（cohesive）、細胞邊界清楚的大型卵圓形細胞，核大而深染、染色質顆粒狀、偶見小核仁，細胞質中等量淡藍色，與周圍分散的造血細胞截然不同，是骨髓轉移性腺癌（乳癌）的細胞團。
features: Cohesive cluster of large oval cells with distinct cell borders and nuclear crowding
Large, round to oval hyperchromatic nuclei with coarse granular chromatin
Occasional small nucleoli; mild nuclear size variation and focal nuclear molding
Moderate pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm without azurophilic granules
Isolated hematopoietic cells (including a band neutrophil) and red cells at the periphery
63687.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a cohesive cluster of large epithelioid cells with well-defined cell borders. The cells have large oval hyperchromatic nuclei with coarse granular chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and moderate pale blue cytoplasm, and they differ clearly from the scattered hematopoietic cells nearby. No hematopoietic maturation is seen within the cluster. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow; in this patient, metastatic breast adenocarcinoma, which can be confirmed by cytokeratin and GATA3 immunostaining on the core biopsy.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells are discohesive with eccentric nuclei, a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm rather than forming tight clusters with shared borders.
Osteoblasts occur in small loose groups with eccentric nuclei and a pale off-nucleus zone (Golgi) and lack nuclear hyperchromasia and crowding.
Blast aggregates in thick areas lack true cell-to-cell cohesion and distinct borders, and are CD45 positive rather than cytokeratin positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic neuroblastoma or small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma shows smaller cells with scant cytoplasm, rosettes and neurofibrillary background, usually in children.

63559.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的嗜中性球胞質中有一條深藍色、兩端圓鈍、周圍帶透亮暈圈的長條形菌體，旁邊另有小空泡，是被吞噬的假菌絲（pseudohypha）片段；單一菌體容易被當成 Döhle body 或血小板而漏看。
features: Neutrophil (arrow) containing a single elongated, deep blue, rod-shaped fungal element surrounded by a clear halo
Organism is larger than a bacterium and lies within a phagocytic vacuole near the nucleus
Additional small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in the infected neutrophil
Neighboring neutrophil and band/metamyelocyte without visible organisms
Thick smear area with crowded, stacked red cells and some crenated cells
63559.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (May-Grünwald stain, 1000x) shows a neutrophil containing a single elongated, deep blue fungal element with a clear surrounding halo within a phagocytic vacuole (arrow), with additional small cytoplasmic vacuoles. Adjacent granulocytes do not contain organisms in this field. The background is a thick area of the smear with crowded, overlapping and partly crenated red cells, which limits assessment of red cell morphology. Findings are consistent with phagocytosed fungal pseudohyphae in a neutrophil, suggestive of fungemia such as Candida; confirmation by blood culture is required.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale, poorly defined blue-grey patches at the cytoplasmic periphery without a refractile wall or halo, unlike this sharply outlined deep blue rod within a vacuole.
Bacilli are smaller, thinner and often multiple, lacking the clear capsule-like halo and width of a fungal element.
An overlying platelet is granular purple with an irregular outline and sits in a different focal plane rather than within a clear vacuole.

63495.recognize_zh: 這是加顯影劑的腹部電腦斷層軸切面：肝左葉有一個邊界不規則、比周圍肝實質稍低密度的大腫塊，影像上有兩條交叉量測線標示其大小；影像無法判斷組織型態，需切片確認（本例為瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤）。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the upper abdomen
Large, relatively hypoattenuating, ill-defined mass in the left hepatic lobe with measurement calipers
Mass bulges the anterior liver contour and abuts the stomach
Stomach contains oral contrast; kidneys, spine, and aorta are unremarkable in this slice
No calcification or obvious fluid-filled cystic component visible
63495.describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT image of the abdomen shows a large, ill-defined, mildly hypoattenuating mass in the left lobe of the liver, marked by measurement calipers (reported as 10 x 7.9 cm). The mass expands the anterior liver contour and abuts the stomach. No calcification or cystic change is evident on this slice. This is a radiologic image without morphologic features; imaging cannot distinguish lymphoma from other hepatic masses, and tissue biopsy (here showing diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type) is required.

ddx.vs: Typically shows arterial phase hyperenhancement with portal venous washout and a capsule in a cirrhotic liver, often with elevated AFP.
Usually multiple lesions with rim enhancement and a known primary, and biopsy shows keratin-positive epithelial cells.
Often shows delayed enhancement with capsular retraction and biliary dilatation, and biopsy shows CK7+ adenocarcinoma.
Shows a rim-enhancing fluid collection with clinical features of infection rather than a solid homogeneous mass.

63303.recognize_zh: 三格序列圖顯示骨髓巨噬細胞以偽足（pseudopodia）接觸造血細胞（A）、偽足包覆該細胞（B）、最後將其吞入胞質形成吞噬體（C），依序呈現噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）的不同階段。
features: Macrophages with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm, irregular cytoplasmic extensions and round nuclei with fine reticular chromatin
Panel A: a round hematopoietic cell with dense chromatin abutting a cytoplasmic projection (pseudopodium) of the macrophage
Panel B: a hematopoietic cell partially enveloped by macrophage cytoplasm, nestled against the macrophage nucleus
Panel C: an ingested cell within macrophage cytoplasm surrounded by a phagosome, with adjacent attached hematopoietic cells
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes, likely drying artifact) and scattered myeloid precursors
63303.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at 100x (panels A-C) illustrates sequential stages of hemophagocytosis by marrow macrophages. In panel A, a hematopoietic cell is attached to a pseudopodial extension of a macrophage; in panel B, macrophage cytoplasm partially surrounds an adherent hematopoietic cell; and in panel C, an ingested cell, reported as a plasma cell, lies within a cytoplasmic phagosome, although its lineage cannot be confirmed with certainty at this resolution. The macrophage nuclei are bland. Background erythrocytes show crenation consistent with artifact. Findings demonstrate active hemophagocytosis, which should be interpreted with clinical and laboratory criteria for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Erythroblasts in an island are arranged around the outside of the macrophage without enclosure in phagosomes.
Superimposed cells lack cytoplasmic envelopment or a phagosome halo and lie in a different focal plane.
In emperipolesis intact cells pass through megakaryocyte cytoplasm, which is granular with a lobulated nucleus, rather than a bland histiocyte.

63239.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片左上方與右下方有灰藍色胞質的單核球樣細胞，胞質內吞入圓形核物質並把自身核推擠到旁邊；吞噬細胞是單核球而不是嗜中性球，對應 tart cell。
features: Monocytoid host cells with gray-blue cytoplasm containing round phagocytosed nuclear bodies
Host nucleus indented or pushed aside by the ingested material
Inclusions are pale lilac; at this magnification residual chromatin texture is subtle, so host-cell type is the main clue
Background cellular aspirate with neutrophils, an eosinophil with cytoplasmic vacuoles, myelocytes, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
63239.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes. Several monocytoid cells with gray-blue cytoplasm contain round, pale lilac phagocytosed nuclear bodies that indent and displace the host nucleus (upper left and lower right of the field). In a true tart cell the ingested nucleus retains some chromatin structure, whereas LE bodies are completely homogeneous; at this resolution the texture of the inclusions is subtle, so the monocytic host cell is the main distinguishing feature. Findings are consistent with tart cells (monocytes with phagocytosed nuclear material) in a patient with systemic lupus erythematosus.

ddx.vs: The host is a neutrophil and the inclusion is a swollen, completely homogeneous, structureless LE body.
Hemophagocytes are larger macrophages engulfing intact red cells, platelets or whole nucleated cells with their own cytoplasm, not an isolated nucleus.
An overlying cell shows its own cytoplasmic rim and crisp chromatin lying on top of, rather than within, the host cytoplasm.

63175.recognize_zh: 這是血庫試管凝集反應在 40 倍顯微鏡下的圖：(a) IgM 抗 D 呈混合視野（Mf）反應，大量游離紅血球中夾雜少量弱凝集團；(b) 稀釋 IgG 抗 D 加抗人球蛋白後出現強凝集團，但因病人 DAT 陽性，這是偽陽性。
features: Labeled two-panel figure of unstained red cell suspensions viewed at 40x
Panel a (monoclonal IgM anti-D): mostly free individual red cells with small weak agglutinates, i.e., mixed-field reaction
Panel b (1:32 diluted IgG anti-D with antiglobulin phase): large dense red cell agglutinates separated by clear spaces
Annotations mark 'free cells', 'weak agglutinates' and 'false positive strong agglutinates'
Serologic readout image; no cellular morphology is being assessed
63175.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic immunohematology figure showing microscopic reading of tube agglutination tests. With monoclonal IgM anti-D (a), the red cells show a mixed-field pattern of predominantly free cells with small weak agglutinates. With diluted IgG anti-D followed by antihuman globulin (b), large strong agglutinates are present; because the patient's red cells are DAT positive (already IgG coated), this antiglobulin-phase reaction is a false positive and the weak D test is invalid. The RhD status is therefore interpreted as indeterminate (mixed field/possible D variant), and RhD-negative red cells should be selected for transfusion.

ddx.vs: A true weak D reacts weakly or not at all with IgM anti-D and becomes positive in the antiglobulin phase only when the DAT and control are negative.

ddx.dx: Mixed-field due to recent transfusion of D-negative or D-positive cells
ddx.vs: A transfused mixed-field reflects two red cell populations and is explained by transfusion history, whereas DAT positivity causes false IAT-phase agglutination.
Partial D lacks specific epitopes and reacts variably with different monoclonal anti-D clones; molecular RHD genotyping, not serology on DAT-positive cells, resolves it.
Rouleaux appear as stacked coin-like chains that disperse with saline replacement, unlike true irregular agglutinates.

63111.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片中可見充滿紅血球的擴張血管腔，腔內有乳頭狀突起（papillary tufts），表面覆蓋飽滿的內襯細胞；這種血管腔加乳頭狀突起的構造是 littoral cell angioma 的特徵。
features: Dilated, blood-filled vascular spaces with free red cells
Papillary projections and tufts protruding into the lumens
Tufts lined by plump, cuboidal cells with ovoid nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
Loose stroma between channels containing lymphocytes and red cells
Scattered desquamated cells in the lumen; no sheets of atypical cells or necrosis
63111.describe_en: Sections of spleen show a vascular lesion composed of dilated, blood-filled channels with papillary fronds projecting into the lumens. The papillae and channel walls are lined by plump, cuboidal to columnar cells with bland ovoid nuclei, and occasional lining cells appear detached into the lumen. There is no significant cytologic atypia, solid growth, or necrosis at this magnification. Findings are consistent with littoral cell angioma.

ddx.vs: Hemangioma has flat, inconspicuous endothelial lining without papillary tufts of plump cells and lacks histiocytic marker coexpression.
Hamartoma is a nodule of disorganized red pulp with slit-like sinusoids that retain CD8 positivity, without cystic papillary channels.
Angiosarcoma shows nuclear pleomorphism, mitoses, solid areas and invasion, which are absent here.
Papillary endothelial hyperplasia is confined to organizing thrombus and its cells lack the CD68/CD21 littoral phenotype.

63047.recognize_zh: CD34 免疫染色下，箭頭所指的是小型、單核或少核葉的巨核細胞，細胞質呈強烈棕色陽性（異常 CD34 表現）；血管內皮也陽性作為內部對照，而周圍造血細胞大多陰性，提示 inv(3) AML 的發育不良巨核細胞。
features: Numerous small megakaryocytes (arrows) with non-lobated or hypolobated round nuclei and strong cytoplasmic CD34 positivity
Aberrant CD34 staining in megakaryocytes of variable size, some mononuclear, others with 2-3 separate nuclei
Linear CD34 staining of endothelium along sinusoidal/vascular walls (internal positive control)
Scattered small CD34-positive mononuclear cells (blasts or hematogones)
Background erythroid, lymphoid and mature myeloid cells negative
63047.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow core biopsy shows numerous small, hypolobated to non-lobated megakaryocytes with strong aberrant cytoplasmic CD34 expression. Endothelial cells lining sinusoids stain as expected, and scattered small to medium CD34-positive mononuclear cells are present, while erythroid, lymphoid and mature myeloid elements are negative. Care must be taken not to count CD34-positive megakaryocytes as blasts. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia with aberrant CD34 expression, as seen in AML with inv(3)(q21.3q26.2)/MECOM rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts are sheets of immature blasts with high N:C ratio that are CD61/CD42b positive and often CD34 variable, rather than recognizable small megakaryocytes with mature cytoplasm.
MDS may also show CD34+ dysplastic megakaryocytes; separation relies on blast percentage and MECOM rearrangement.
Blasts are small to medium round mononuclear cells with scant cytoplasm, whereas these positive cells have abundant cytoplasm and megakaryocytic nuclei confirmable with CD61.

ddx.dx: Essential thrombocythemia or reactive megakaryocytic hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes in ET and reactive states are large and hyperlobated and CD34 negative.

62983.recognize_zh: CT 可見骨盆骨硬化與薦骨病灶（箭頭），骨髓切片低倍下細胞量近 100%；淋巴結 H&E 可見細胞質透亮、核被推擠到一側的印戒細胞（signet ring cells），骨髓免疫染色則只見零星散在的陽性上皮細胞，提示轉移癌伴隨續發性骨髓纖維化。
features: CT (A): diffuse sclerosis of the lumbar spine and pelvic bones with a focal sacral lesion (arrow)
BM biopsy low power (B): markedly hypercellular (~100%) marrow core with thin bony trabeculae and no fat
LN H&E (C): nests and sheets of epithelial cells with abundant clear to mucin-filled cytoplasm and peripherally displaced nuclei (signet ring cells) adjacent to residual lymphoid tissue
BM IHC (D): only rare, scattered single positive cells within the marrow, without cohesive tumor clusters
Fibrosis is not directly assessable in this composite (no reticulin/trichrome panel shown)
62983.describe_en: Composite figure. Axial CT shows diffuse sclerosis of the pelvic bones with a focal sacral lesion. The bone marrow trephine biopsy is markedly hypercellular (approaching 100%) at low power. A lymph node biopsy shows infiltration by poorly cohesive carcinoma cells with abundant intracytoplasmic mucin and eccentric crescentic nuclei (signet ring cells) adjacent to residual lymphoid tissue. An epithelial immunostain on the marrow highlights only rare, scattered single tumor cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic signet ring cell adenocarcinoma (gastric primary) involving lymph node and bone marrow, with associated secondary marrow fibrosis and osteosclerosis.

ddx.vs: Primary myelofibrosis shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and a driver mutation (JAK2/CALR/MPL), without keratin-positive epithelial cells on IHC.

ddx.dx: Histiocytes or signet-ring lymphoma mimicking carcinoma
ddx.vs: Foamy histiocytes are CD68/CD163-positive and keratin-negative, whereas signet ring carcinoma cells are cytokeratin-positive and mucin (PAS/mucicarmine)-positive.

ddx.dx: Osteoblastic metastasis from prostate or breast carcinoma
ddx.vs: Morphology is not signet ring, and site-specific IHC (NKX3.1/PSA, GATA3/ER) and the CK7+ gastric-type profile separate them.

62919.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下可見一群中至大型母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻、部分核有凹陷或切跡，核仁隱約可見，細胞質稀少且無顆粒；其間夾雜兩個細胞質較多、深藍色的細胞（可能為漿細胞），需以流式確認 T 淋巴母細胞表型。
features: Intermediate-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio and scant agranular cytoplasm
Nuclei round to irregular with indentations/notches
Finely granular to slightly stippled chromatin with indistinct small nucleoli
Two cells with denser chromatin and more abundant deep blue cytoplasm, possibly plasma cells
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules; background of bare nuclei and platelet debris
62919.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at oil immersion shows a cluster of intermediate-to-large blasts with high N:C ratios, scant agranular cytoplasm, finely granular chromatin, indistinct nucleoli, and irregular, notched nuclear contours. Two interspersed cells with denser chromatin and more abundant deep blue cytoplasm may represent plasma cells. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are seen. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage; with MPO negativity and cCD3, CD5, and TdT expression by flow cytometry, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia accompanied by reactive plasmacytosis.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts look identical but express CD19, CD79a, and PAX5 without cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Minimally differentiated AML blasts are MPO-negative by cytochemistry but express CD13/CD33/CD117 and MPO by flow, without cCD3.
ETP-ALL shows cCD3+ blasts lacking CD1a/CD8, with weak CD5 and stem/myeloid markers; CD33 expression here warrants this consideration by flow.
Neoplastic plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin, and perinuclear hof with light-chain restriction, whereas here the plasma cells were polyclonal.

62855.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織被纖維化的梭形細胞基質取代，中央有數個被巨細胞包圍的結節，內含放射狀排列的透明結晶，旁邊是骨小樑；只有右下角殘存少量造血細胞，是草酸鈣沉積造成骨髓纖維化的表現。
features: Marrow space replaced by loose fibrotic stroma with spindle cells
Central nodules containing radiating aggregates of colorless crystals rimmed by giant cells
Adjacent bony trabeculae with irregular outlines
Residual hematopoietic cells confined to a small area at the lower right corner
No atypical megakaryocytes or tumor cell clusters in this field
62855.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at medium power shows marked replacement of the marrow space by fibrotic spindle-cell stroma between bony trabeculae. Several nodules containing radiating aggregates of colorless crystals rimmed by multinucleated giant cells are present centrally, and residual hematopoietic tissue is limited to a small focus at the lower right. No atypical megakaryocytic clusters or epithelial tumor cells are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow fibrosis secondary to calcium oxalate crystal deposition (oxalosis), with confirmation by polarized light.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and no crystal-containing granulomas.
Metastasis shows cohesive cytokeratin-positive tumor nests within fibrosis instead of crystal rosettes.
Osteitis fibrosa shows peritrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclastic resorption but lacks birefringent crystal deposits.
Infectious granulomas have epithelioid histiocytes, possible necrosis and organisms, without crystalline material.

62727.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下整片為成熟脂肪細胞，脂肪細胞之間的間隙夾雜著成群的小型造血細胞與紅血球，外觀像「長在脂肪裡的骨髓」，配合腎上腺腫塊的臨床，即腎上腺骨髓脂肪瘤（myelolipoma）。
features: Sheets of mature univacuolated adipocytes of variable size occupying most of the field
Interstitial clusters of hematopoietic cells filling the spaces between fat cells
Mixed small round hematopoietic nuclei (erythroid and myeloid precursors) with admixed red cells
No lipoblasts, atypical stromal cells or adrenal cortical cells in this field
62727.describe_en: Section of the adrenal mass at low power shows mature adipose tissue composed of univacuolated adipocytes, with interspersed aggregates of trilineage-appearing hematopoietic cells and red cells occupying the interstitial spaces. No lipoblasts, cytologic atypia or residual adrenal cortical tissue is seen in this field; individual lineages are difficult to resolve at this magnification. Findings are consistent with adrenal myelolipoma.

ddx.vs: Usually occurs in patients with marrow failure or chronic hemolysis and forms hematopoietic tissue masses without a prominent mature adipose component.
Contains atypical hyperchromatic stromal cells and lipoblasts with MDM2 amplification, and lacks admixed trilineage hematopoiesis.
Contains thick-walled vessels and HMB45/Melan-A positive smooth muscle-like cells rather than hematopoietic elements.
Bone marrow contains bony trabeculae, whereas myelolipoma is an encapsulated adrenal mass without bone.

62663.recognize_zh: 左側淋巴竇內有一群大型細胞，細胞質豐富、界線清楚、核大有核仁，與右側由小淋巴球層層環繞的濾泡形成對比；大細胞位於竇內（intrasinusoidal）是結外型 PEL 在淋巴結的典型分布。
features: Cluster of large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and distinct borders lining/filling a sinus
Large vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli in the sinus cells
Adjacent follicle with small germinal center surrounded by concentric layers of small mantle lymphocytes
Germinal center contains pale histiocytes/dendritic cells and small vessels
Small lymphocytes and scattered plasma cells in the interfollicular area
62663.describe_en: H&E section of a lymph node shows a sinus on the left filled and lined by large neoplastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, distinct borders and large vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli. To the right is a follicle with a small germinal center surrounded by concentric layers of small mantle-zone lymphocytes. The contrast highlights the intrasinusoidal distribution of the large atypical cells within otherwise preserved nodal tissue. Findings are consistent with sinusoidal involvement by extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma in the context of HHV8 positivity.

ddx.vs: Also intrasinusoidal large cells, but with hallmark horseshoe nuclei, strong CD30, ALK or T-cell markers and HHV8 negativity.
Cohesive cells with cytokeratin positivity and absent hematolymphoid markers.
Sinus histiocytes have bland oval nuclei without prominent nucleoli and are CD68/CD163 positive.

62599.recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色中成片腫瘤細胞完全不著色，只有極少數散在的小 B 細胞呈膜狀陽性，顯示腫瘤喪失 B 細胞標記，符合漿細胞分化的單形性 PTLD。
features: Diffuse sheet of tumor cells with round-oval nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, CD20-negative
Only rare (2–3) scattered small cells with membranous CD20 staining as internal positive control
Nuclei show fine chromatin with small nucleoli on hematoxylin counterstain
No residual B-cell follicles in field
62599.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows the diffuse neoplastic infiltrate to be negative, with only rare scattered residual small B cells staining as an internal control. Loss of CD20 in a lymphoid neoplasm indicates terminal plasma cell differentiation or a non-B-cell origin and should prompt plasma cell markers (CD138, MUM1) and light-chain studies. In conjunction with MUM1 positivity, EBER positivity and light-chain restriction, findings are consistent with plasmacytoma-like PTLD.

ddx.vs: DLBCL-type PTLD is typically diffusely CD20-positive, whereas this tumor is CD20-negative.
Also CD20-negative and MUM1-positive; it is distinguished by immunoblastic cytology with prominent nucleoli and Ki-67 >90%.
PEL is CD20-negative too but is HHV8/LANA-positive, which is not a feature of plasmacytoma-like PTLD.
T-cell lesions are CD20-negative but express CD3 and other T-cell antigens, whereas CD3 here highlights only background cells.

62535.recognize_zh: S100 染色中大型組織球的細胞核與細胞質皆呈強陽性；畫面中央一個 S100+ 組織球的細胞質內包著多個完整的淋巴球（周圍有空暈），即淋巴球穿入現象（emperipolesis），這是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的典型表現。
features: Large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S100 positivity
Central S100-positive histiocyte containing several intact lymphocytes with clear halos (emperipolesis)
Abundant, ill-defined cytoplasm of the S100-positive cells
Background of S100-negative small lymphocytes and plasma cells (blue nuclei)
62535.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for S100 shows numerous large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining and abundant cytoplasm. Several of these cells contain intact small lymphocytes within clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, a feature accentuated by the S100 stain that represents emperipolesis. The surrounding small lymphocytes and plasma cells are negative. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy).

ddx.vs: LCH cells are also S100-positive but have grooved coffee-bean nuclei, lack emperipolesis, and are CD1a and langerin positive.
Reactive sinus histiocytes are S100-negative (CD68/CD163-positive only) and show no significant emperipolesis.
Melanoma cells are S100-positive but show nuclear atypia and prominent nucleoli, express SOX10/Melan-A, and lack the histiocyte markers CD68/CD163.

62471.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中手掌皮膚明顯角化增厚、脫屑並有深裂紋，合併散在的深色色素斑與色素不均，符合蕈狀肉芽腫／Sézary 症候群常見的手掌角化症（palmar keratoderma）表現。
features: Clinical photograph of the palmar surface of the hand
Diffuse thickened, hyperkeratotic skin with scaling and deep fissures, most prominent over palm and finger creases
Mottled hyperpigmentation with irregular dark brown macules and patches
Shiny, erythematous-appearing area at the thenar base with superficial erosion
No discrete tumor nodules or ulcerated masses visible
62471.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the palm shows diffuse hyperkeratosis with scaling and fissuring, accompanied by mottled hyperpigmentation and scattered dark macules; a smoother, eroded-appearing area is present at the thenar base. No tumor nodules are seen. This is a clinical rather than microscopic image, and the findings are nonspecific in isolation. In the context of known mycosis fungoides with blood involvement, the appearance is compatible with palmoplantar keratoderma, a feature frequently seen in erythrodermic mycosis fungoides or Sezary syndrome.

ddx.vs: Eczema lacks circulating clonal CD4+ T cells, and skin biopsy shows spongiosis without epidermotropic atypical lymphocytes.
Psoriasis shows well-demarcated plaques with silvery scale and nail pitting, with psoriasiform hyperplasia and neutrophils rather than atypical lymphocytes on biopsy.
PRP produces orange-waxy keratoderma with islands of sparing and follicular papules, and biopsy lacks clonal T-cell infiltrate.

62407.recognize_zh: 胃黏膜免疫染色（紅色呈色劑）中，腺體表面與腺腔黏液內可見許多細小、紅色的彎曲桿狀物，即幽門螺旋桿菌（H. pylori）；固有層有淋巴漿細胞浸潤——H. pylori 感染與胃 MALT 淋巴瘤的發生密切相關。
features: Gastric mucosa with foveolar epithelium and glands, hematoxylin counterstain
Numerous small red, curved to rod-shaped organisms in surface mucus and along the luminal epithelium
Organisms concentrated in the mucus layer between mucosal fragments rather than within the lamina propria
Lamina propria densely cellular with lymphoplasmacytic cells
No lymphoepithelial lesions assessable on this immunostain
62407.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for Helicobacter pylori with red chromogen on gastric mucosa shows numerous small, curved rod-shaped organisms within the surface mucus and along the luminal aspect of the foveolar epithelium. The lamina propria is densely cellular with a lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate. Organisms are not seen within the lamina propria. Findings confirm H. pylori infection, the principal antigenic driver of gastric extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT type; eradication status is relevant to management, and t(11;18) should be assessed to predict response.

ddx.vs: H. heilmannii organisms are longer with tight corkscrew spirals and are sparser, although they may cross-react with H. pylori antibodies.
Artifactual staining is amorphous and granular without the uniform curved bacillary shape of true organisms.
Contaminating bacteria are variable in morphology (cocci and straight rods), do not hug the foveolar surface and are negative for H. pylori IHC.

ddx.dx: Reactive chronic gastritis without MALT lymphoma
ddx.vs: H. pylori is present in both, so lymphoma requires a dense monotonous B-cell infiltrate with lymphoepithelial lesions and clonality.

62343.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下脂肪比例偏高，但骨小樑旁與間質中有一片細胞質較多、淡粉紅色的較大細胞聚集，與周圍小而深染的造血細胞不同，提示漿細胞病灶；低倍下無法確認細胞種類，需高倍或 CD138 佐證。
features: Bone marrow core with abundant adipocytes and reduced overall cellularity
Patchy aggregates of larger cells with moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, including near a trabecula
Residual hematopoiesis with small dark erythroid/myeloid precursors between fat cells
Scattered megakaryocytes present
Bony trabeculae without obvious lytic remodeling at this magnification
62343.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a hypocellular-appearing marrow with abundant adipose tissue and two bony trabeculae. Between fat spaces there are patchy, partly paratrabecular aggregates of larger cells with moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, distinct from the surrounding smaller residual hematopoietic cells; megakaryocytes are present. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, and the nature of the aggregates requires higher-power review and CD138/light-chain immunostaining. In the given clinical context, findings are suggestive of focal involvement by plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive nests often with desmoplastic stroma and is keratin-positive/CD138 variable, whereas myeloma aggregates are discohesive plasma cells that are CD138-positive and light-chain restricted.
Reactive plasma cells are scattered singly or around vessels and are polytypic, not forming patchy sheets of atypical cells.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes and CD34-positive blast clusters rather than aggregates of CD138-positive plasma cells.

62279.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下，淋巴結中央有一個大而拉長、邊界不清的結節，大部分由深染的小淋巴球構成，其內夾雜淡染斑塊；右下方可見淋巴結被膜與血管，周圍仍保有一般淋巴組織，提示 PTGC。
features: Large, elongated, ill-defined lymphoid nodule dominating the field, much larger than a normal secondary follicle
Predominance of small, dark lymphocytes with irregular paler areas within the nodule (fragmented germinal centers)
Surrounding interfollicular tissue with small vessels and the fibrous nodal capsule at the lower right
Retraction/cleft artifacts traversing the nodule
Cytologic detail not resolvable at this magnification; no obvious sclerosis or necrosis
62279.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows a large, poorly delineated lymphoid nodule composed predominantly of small lymphocytes, containing irregular paler areas suggestive of disrupted germinal center remnants. The adjacent node shows interfollicular tissue with vessels and an intact fibrous capsule at the edge of the field. There is no sclerosis or necrosis, and cellular detail cannot be assessed at this power. Findings are suggestive of progressive transformation of germinal centers; correlation with IgD, CD10, BCL2 and PD-1 immunostains and high-power examination for LP cells is required.

ddx.vs: NLPHL shows effacement by multiple nodules containing CD20+/OCT2+ LP cells rosetted by PD-1+ T cells, whereas PTGC lacks LP cells and occurs amid reactive follicles.

Follicular lymphoma has crowded uniform follicles with BCL2-positive germinal center B cells and attenuated mantles, unlike the mantle-cell-rich PTGC nodule with BCL2-negative germinal center remnants.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Marginal zone lymphoma shows expanded monocytoid/marginal zone B cells that are IgD-negative with light-chain restriction, whereas the PTGC nodule is composed of polytypic IgD+ mantle cells.

62215.recognize_zh: 這是 FDG PET 最大強度投影（MIP）灰階影像（翻拍螢幕，解析度低），全身中軸骨、肋骨、骨盆與近端股骨、肱骨出現多發攝取灶，呈廣泛骨髓浸潤分布；腦部與膀胱為生理性攝取。
features: Whole-body maximum intensity projection FDG PET image, photographed from a monitor with low resolution
Multifocal tracer-avid foci throughout the ribs, spine and pelvis
Uptake extending into proximal femora and humeri (appendicular marrow)
Intense physiologic activity in the brain and urinary bladder
Large area of increased activity in the upper abdomen (liver region) that cannot be separated from physiologic uptake on this image
62215.describe_en: Whole-body FDG PET maximum intensity projection image shows numerous tracer-avid foci distributed throughout the axial skeleton, including the ribs, vertebrae and pelvis, with extension into the proximal femora and humeri. Physiologic activity is present in the brain and urinary bladder. Upper abdominal activity in the region of the liver is prominent but cannot be characterized further on this low-resolution photograph. The multifocal skeletal pattern is suggestive of widespread bone marrow metastases, which in this patient correlates with marrow-proven metastatic breast carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow uptake is diffuse and homogeneous rather than composed of discrete multifocal foci.

ddx.dx: Hematologic malignancy with marrow involvement (myeloma, lymphoma)
ddx.vs: These can show the same multifocal skeletal pattern, and biopsy is required to establish the tissue diagnosis.

62087.recognize_zh: 母細胞核呈折疊、雙葉或腎形（A、B 可見核摺痕），細胞質淡紫、細顆粒不明顯；D 圖一群細胞邊緣有許多細小的細胞質泡突與芽狀突起，外觀類似小巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte），這是微顆粒型 APL 的易誤判表現。
features: Medium-to-large blasts/abnormal promyelocytes with high N:C ratio
Folded, bilobed or reniform nuclei with visible nuclear creases (panels A-B)
Fine chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Basophilic to lilac cytoplasm with very fine, dust-like granules; no Auer rods seen
Prominent cytoplasmic blebs and budding projections around the cell periphery (panels C-D), mimicking micromegakaryocytes/megakaryoblasts
62087.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear panels show medium-to-large abnormal cells with folded to bilobed nuclei, fine chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is lilac to basophilic with only very fine, dust-like granularity, and several cells (C, D) display numerous cytoplasmic blebs and budding projections that mimic micromegakaryocytes or megakaryoblasts. Auer rods are not identified in these fields. Given the nuclear folding and hypogranular cytoplasm, findings are suggestive of the microgranular variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia with unusual cytoplasmic projections; strong MPO positivity, CD34-/HLA-DR- phenotype, and PML::RARA confirmation are required to avoid misclassification as megakaryoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts also bleb but are MPO-negative and CD41/CD61-positive, whereas APL cells are strongly MPO-positive and PML::RARA-positive.
Promonocytes have folded nuclei but gray-blue cytoplasm with vacuoles, are NSE-positive and usually HLA-DR positive.

ddx.dx: MDS or MPN with circulating micromegakaryocytes
ddx.vs: True micromegakaryocytes have dense mature chromatin, a single small round nucleus, and platelet-like granular cytoplasm rather than fine blast chromatin with folded nuclei.

61959.recognize_zh: CD8染色只在少數散在的小淋巴球呈強膜狀陽性，而佔多數的大型腫瘤細胞（核大、淡染）為陰性，表示腫瘤細胞CD8陰性、陽性者為反應性T細胞。
features: Scattered small lymphocytes with strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD8 staining
Large neoplastic cells with pale vesicular nuclei are CD8-negative
Positive cells are a minority and occasionally form small clusters
Faint dot-like nonspecific granular staining in the background
61959.describe_en: CD8 immunostain highlights scattered small reactive lymphocytes with strong membranous staining, occasionally in small clusters, while the predominant population of large cells with vesicular nuclei is negative. The neoplastic cells are therefore CD8-negative, in keeping with the CD4-positive phenotype seen in this case of ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: This entity shows CD8-positive neoplastic cells with epidermotropism and usually lacks strong uniform CD30, unlike the CD8-negative large cells here.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic or other cytotoxic T-cell lymphomas
ddx.vs: These often express CD8 or are CD4/CD8 double-negative with gamma-delta TCR, rather than CD4+/CD30+ large cells.

61895.recognize_zh: 皮下脂肪與真皮交界的淋巴浸潤中，CD8 僅在極少數散在細胞呈陽性，大多數浸潤淋巴球為陰性；這是 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）免疫表型中的 CD8 染色。
features: Subcutaneous adipose tissue and deep dermis with a moderately dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate
Only rare scattered CD8-positive cells
Large majority of lymphoid nuclei CD8 negative
No adipocyte rimming by CD8-positive cells
Infiltrating cells small to medium with irregular, somewhat elongated nuclei on hematoxylin counterstain
61895.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD8 on a skin biopsy shows a moderately dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate extending into subcutaneous fat. Only rare scattered cells are CD8 positive, and the great majority of infiltrating lymphocytes are negative. There is no rimming of adipocytes by CD8-positive cells. This pattern argues against a CD8-predominant cytotoxic T-cell process and should be integrated with CD3, CD4, CD56 and EBER results in the evaluation of hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: SPTCL shows atypical CD8-positive, beta F1-positive cells rimming adipocytes and is EBER negative, whereas CD8-positive cells are rare here.
Gamma-delta TCL is typically CD4/CD8 double negative with TCR-delta expression and cytotoxic markers, often with epidermotropism, necrosis and an aggressive course, and is usually EBER negative.
Lupus panniculitis contains mixed CD4/CD8 T cells, B-cell aggregates, clusters of CD123-positive plasmacytoid dendritic cells and hyaline fat necrosis without EBV-infected lymphocytes.

61831.recognize_zh: 低倍針狀切片中，一大團邊界清楚、密集的多形腫瘤細胞結節取代周圍含脂肪的組織，結節內可見散在的大型奇異細胞；低倍僅能看出浸潤性大細胞腫瘤，需高倍與 CD68/CD163/PU.1 才能確立組織球肉瘤。
features: Needle core biopsy with a large, well-circumscribed, densely cellular tumor nodule
Tumor composed of large cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and scattered large bizarre nuclei
Surrounding tissue with adipocytes, vessels, and fibrous septa partly infiltrated by similar cells
Sheet-like, effacing growth without glandular or follicular architecture
Precise anatomic site and cytologic detail limited at this magnification
61831.describe_en: Low-power view of a needle core biopsy shows a large, fairly well-circumscribed nodule of densely packed large neoplastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and scattered bizarre enlarged nuclei, surrounded by tissue containing adipocytes, vessels, and fibrous septa that are focally infiltrated by similar cells. There is no glandular, nested epithelial, or follicular architecture. The anatomic site and fine cytologic features cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. With higher-power morphology and a CD68+/CD163+/PU.1+ immunophenotype, findings are consistent with involvement by histiocytic sarcoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows sheets of large lymphoid cells with less cytoplasm and is CD20/PAX5 positive and CD163 negative.
Carcinoma nests are cohesive with desmoplastic stroma and keratin positivity.
Myeloid sarcoma consists of more monotonous blasts with fine chromatin and MPO/CD34/CD117 expression, often with eosinophilic myelocytes.
cHL has scattered CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin cells in an abundant reactive background rather than sheets of large pleomorphic histiocytoid cells.

61767.recognize_zh: SOX11 免疫染色中，大多數中型腫瘤細胞呈棕色核染色（強度不一），少數小細胞為藍色陰性；腫瘤細胞核 SOX11 陽性是被套細胞淋巴瘤（包含 Cyclin D1 陰性病例）的重要佐證。
features: Nuclear SOX11 positivity in the majority of tumor cells, with variable intensity
Positive nuclei are medium-sized, round to slightly irregular
Scattered small SOX11-negative nuclei (likely reactive lymphocytes or stromal cells)
No significant cytoplasmic staining
61767.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry for SOX11 shows nuclear positivity of variable intensity in the majority of medium-sized tumor cells, with admixed small negative cells. The staining is nuclear and diffuse across the field. SOX11 expression in a mature B-cell neoplasm supports mantle cell lymphoma and is particularly useful when cyclin D1 is negative or equivocal. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant, in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma can be SOX11-positive but is CD10-positive with MYC rearrangement, near-100% Ki-67, and lacks CD5 and cyclin D1.
Lymphoblastic neoplasms may express SOX11 but are TdT-positive and lack surface immunoglobulin.
CLL/SLL is also CD5-positive but is SOX11-negative and LEF1/CD23-positive.

61703.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中滿布漿細胞，核偏位、細胞質豐富深藍並有核旁淡染區（hof），部分細胞較大、染色質較細且可見核仁，並有雙核細胞；成群的非典型漿細胞是漿細胞骨髓瘤的典型抹片表現。
features: Sheets of plasma cells dominating the aspirate
Eccentric round nuclei; many with dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli (immature/plasmablastic features)
Abundant deep basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Binucleate and multinucleate forms and cells with nuclear irregularity
Occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles; background red cells and rare residual hematopoietic cells
61703.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and prominent perinuclear hofs. Many cells show immature features, including larger size, dispersed chromatin, and visible nucleoli, with occasional binucleate forms. Residual normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma, and a formal differential count is needed to quantify the clonal plasma cell percentage.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, small, usually below 10-20% and polytypic, without sheets of immature or binucleate forms.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has larger immunoblastic cells with high Ki-67 and frequent EBER positivity, usually presenting as an extramedullary mass in immunocompromised patients.
LPL aspirates show a mix of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes, not a pure population of immature plasma cells.

61639.recognize_zh: MUM1 染色中一群較大的細胞核呈強弱不一的棕色核染色，散在於陰性的小造血細胞之間，另有少數強陽性的漿細胞；大型腫瘤細胞 MUM1 陽性表示非生發中心（activated B-cell）表現型，這是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤常見的表型。
features: Nuclear MUM1/IRF4 staining of variable intensity in a population of large cells
Positive large nuclei oval with vesicular chromatin, some with cytoplasmic blush
Few small cells with very strong nuclear staining (likely plasma cells)
Small hematopoietic cells in the background negative
