Positive cells scattered and loosely clustered near fat spaces/sinusoids
61639.describe_en: MUM1/IRF4 immunostain of the bone marrow biopsy shows nuclear staining of variable intensity in scattered and loosely clustered large cells, several located along vascular spaces adjacent to fat. A few smaller cells with intense nuclear staining likely represent plasma cells, and the background hematopoietic cells are negative. MUM1 expression in the large atypical cells indicates a non-germinal center (activated B-cell) phenotype, which is typical of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma. Findings support the diagnosis in conjunction with CD20 and the intrasinusoidal distribution.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are small to medium with eccentric nuclei and uniformly strong MUM1 and CD138, and are not CD20-positive large cells within sinusoids.
Neoplastic plasma cells are MUM1 and CD138 positive but CD20 negative, with light chain restriction and interstitial or sheet-like distribution.
GCB-type lymphoma typically is CD10/BCL6 positive and MUM1 negative.

61575.recognize_zh: 細胞內染色的流式圖中，紅色母細胞群 cytoplasmic CD79a 陽性、cytoplasmic CD22 弱陽性到陰性，紫色細胞 cCD79a 與 cCD22 皆陽性，綠色非 B 細胞兩者皆陰性；cCD79a 陽性可指定 B 淋巴系，支持 B-ALL。
features: Ungated ([U]) bivariate dot plot: cytoplasmic CD22-APC700 (x-axis) versus cytoplasmic CD79a-APC (y-axis)
Red (blast) population cCD79a-positive, with cCD22 ranging from negative to dim
Purple population cCD79a-positive and cCD22 dim-to-moderate positive, forming a diagonal cluster
Green population negative for both markers (non-B cells), serving as internal negative control
No discrete population bright for cCD22 above 10^1
61575.describe_en: This intracellular flow cytometry dot plot displays cytoplasmic CD22 versus cytoplasmic CD79a on ungated events. The blast population (red) is cytoplasmic CD79a-positive with cytoplasmic CD22 expression ranging from negative to dim, while a purple population coexpresses cCD79a and dim-to-moderate cCD22 along a diagonal. Green non-B events are negative for both markers and serve as an internal negative control. Cytoplasmic CD79a positivity in the blasts, together with CD19 expression, establishes B-lineage and supports B-lymphoblastic leukemia; the relatively dim cCD22 is noteworthy because CD22 expression level may influence eligibility for anti-CD22 therapy such as inotuzumab.

ddx.vs: cCD79a can be positive in some T-ALL, but blasts express cytoplasmic CD3 and lack strong CD19.
Requires additional MPO or monocytic differentiation markers on the same or separate blast population.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with aberrant B markers (e.g., t(8;21))
ddx.vs: May show CD19/cCD79a weakly but is MPO-positive with CD34/CD117 and lacks strong CD10/cCD22.

61447.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有許多胞質豐富淡染的大型組織球，其胞質內含小圓形、帶透明暈的菌體或被吞噬的紅血球樣結構，周圍混有小淋巴球；可提示組織漿菌感染合併噬血現象，但本圖放大倍率下兩者不易區分，需特殊染色佐證。
features: Increased large histiocytes with abundant pale, granular to vacuolated cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei
Small round intracytoplasmic structures with clear halos within histiocytes (right center), compatible with yeast forms or engulfed red cells
Dense background of small lymphocytes and hematopoietic cells, some with dark condensed nuclei
Occasional histiocyte appears to contain phagocytosed cellular material (possible hemophagocytosis)
Resolution limits distinction of yeasts from phagocytosed erythrocytes
61447.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows an increase in large histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm admixed with small lymphocytes and hematopoietic precursors. Several histiocytes contain small round intracytoplasmic bodies with surrounding clear halos, compatible with Histoplasma yeast forms, and some appear to contain engulfed cells suggestive of hemophagocytosis. At this magnification, yeasts cannot be reliably separated from ingested red cells. Findings are suggestive of marrow histoplasmosis with associated hemophagocytosis; GMS/PAS stains and CD163 immunostain are recommended, and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis remains a clinical diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Amastigotes show a kinetoplast and are GMS-negative, and can also trigger HLH.
Hemophagocytic histiocytes are present without intracellular organisms, and an underlying lymphoma must be excluded by immunostains.
Foamy histiocytes contain acid-fast bacilli on AFB stain rather than haloed yeasts.
Cytoplasm shows striated crinkled-paper texture without discrete intracellular organisms.

61383.recognize_zh: A 圖抹片中有一顆比嗜中性球大好幾倍的巨大原紅血球（giant pronormoblast），細胞質深藍並有偽足狀突起；B 圖骨髓切片可見多顆巨大紅血球前驅細胞，細胞核內有大型均質、周圍帶透明暈的包涵體（lantern cell），這兩者是 parvovirus B19 感染造成純紅血球再生不良的典型表現。
features: Panel A: giant pronormoblast several times the size of adjacent neutrophils, with a large round nucleus, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with bleb-like pseudopods
Panel A: segmented neutrophils and red cells with central pallor for size comparison; no maturing erythroid forms seen
Panel B: section with markedly enlarged erythroid precursors containing large, homogeneous, glassy intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo (lantern cells)
Panel B: background maturing myeloid cells; later-stage erythroid precursors not evident
Section stain in panel B is not specified and resolution is limited
61383.describe_en: The aspirate smear (A) shows a giant pronormoblast with a large nucleus, fine chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm bearing pseudopod-like blebs, adjacent to normal segmented neutrophils; maturing erythroid precursors are not seen in this field. The marrow section (B) shows several markedly enlarged erythroid precursors with large homogeneous intranuclear viral inclusions surrounded by a clear halo, set in a background of maturing myeloid cells. These findings are characteristic of parvovirus B19 cytopathic effect with erythroid maturation arrest. In the clinical setting of severe acute anemia with a positive DAT, the findings are consistent with pure red cell aplasia due to parvovirus B19 superimposed on autoimmune hemolytic anemia; confirmation by parvovirus B19 PCR or immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows sheets of neoplastic pronormoblasts with high blast count, complex karyotype and TP53 mutation, rather than scattered giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear viral inclusions.
Shows a full spectrum of large erythroid precursors with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes, rather than maturation arrest at the pronormoblast stage.

ddx.dx: Immune-mediated pure red cell aplasia (thymoma, T-LGL)
ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors are absent without giant pronormoblasts or intranuclear inclusions, and parvovirus PCR is negative.
Shows binucleated or multinucleated late erythroblasts with internuclear bridging rather than giant early precursors with viral inclusions.

61319.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一個巨核細胞，核分成數個彼此分離、圓胖的核葉，細胞質豐富且帶細緻粉紅顆粒，邊緣未見明顯血小板脫落；ITP 可見此類形態變化，但分離核葉也見於骨髓增生不良症候群，屬非特異表現。
features: Large megakaryocyte with several discrete, rounded, widely separated nuclear lobes
Abundant finely granular pink cytoplasm
No obvious platelet budding at the cell margin
Surrounding small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors, and a neutrophil
Thick smear area with poorly spread grey red cells
61319.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a megakaryocyte with multiple discrete, rounded nuclear lobes that appear separated from one another, and abundant finely granular cytoplasm without evident platelet budding. Adjacent marrow cells include lymphocytes, erythroid precursors, and a neutrophil in a thick area with poorly spread red cells. Megakaryocytic morphologic alterations of this type have been reported in immune thrombocytopenia, but separated nuclear lobes are nonspecific and are also a dysplastic feature. Correlation with the peripheral smear, clinical history, and evaluation of other lineages for dysplasia is recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS shows multinucleated megakaryocytes with separated lobes in ≥10% of megakaryocytes together with micromegakaryocytes and dysplasia in other lineages.
Megaloblastic marrow shows hypersegmented megakaryocytes together with megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes.
Osteoclasts have many uniform, separate oval nuclei with single nucleoli and non-granular cytoplasm, rather than lobulated megakaryocytic nuclei.

61255.recognize_zh: 組圖 B 的周邊血嗜中性球細胞質內有多個大小不一、邊界清楚的透亮空泡（插圖放大更清楚），而非顆粒或吞噬物，即 Jordans anomaly；A 為組織切片中細胞內空泡化（箭頭，脂質堆積），C 為另一白血球作比較。此發現提示中性脂質儲積症（neutral lipid storage disease）。
features: Panel B: neutrophils with multiple discrete, round, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles of varying size (inset at higher magnification)
Neutrophil nuclei segmented with otherwise normal chromatin; vacuoles not associated with toxic granulation or ingested organisms
Panel A (H&E tissue, likely muscle): cluster of cells with finely vacuolated, foamy cytoplasm (arrow) consistent with intracellular lipid accumulation
Panel C: separate smear field with a single leukocyte for comparison among red cells
Red cells in panel B show refractile central artifact; resolution of the composite is low
61255.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils containing multiple discrete, round, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles of varying size, without toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or intracellular organisms. The accompanying tissue section shows cells with finely vacuolated, lipid-laden cytoplasm (arrow). An additional leukocyte is shown in a separate smear field for comparison. Because vacuolization is present in a fresh, well-prepared smear and is associated with tissue lipid accumulation, it is not attributable to storage artifact. Findings are consistent with Jordans anomaly, suggestive of neutral lipid storage disease (PNPLA2 or ABHD5 deficiency); Oil Red O staining and genetic testing are confirmatory.

ddx.vs: Accompanied by toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, occurs with acute infection and resolves, whereas Jordans anomaly vacuoles are lipid-containing, persistent and present in nearly all granulocytes.
Vacuoles appear after prolonged sample storage and are absent on a fresh smear, and are not Oil Red O positive.
Shows giant fused azurophilic granules rather than clear empty vacuoles.
Shows dense dark purple granules in neutrophils instead of clear vacuoles.

61191.recognize_zh: 周邊血中出現含大量紫紅色顆粒、核呈卵圓且偏心的大細胞（A–C），骨髓中有多核、顆粒化的異型細胞（D、E），MPO 細胞化學呈陰性（F），切片瀰漫浸潤並有免疫染色陽性（H、I），提示這些高顆粒細胞是肥大細胞而非 APL 前骨髓細胞。
features: Panels A-C (blood): circulating large cells with oval, centrally or eccentrically placed nuclei and cytoplasm packed with purple-red granules; one cell with a long cytoplasmic tail
Panels D-E (marrow aspirate): large bi- and multinucleated cells with round nuclei and granular cytoplasm alongside hypergranular mononuclear cells
Panel F: cytochemical stain in which the large pale cells are negative while an adjacent granulocyte shows brown positive granules (internal control)
Panel G: cytochemical/metachromatic stain highlighting purple-red granules in large pale cells
Panel H: trephine biopsy with a diffuse hypercellular infiltrate replacing marrow fat
Panel I: immunohistochemistry showing diffuse strong positivity of the infiltrate
61191.describe_en: Composite figure shows circulating large hypergranular cells with oval nuclei and cytoplasm crowded with purple-red granules, some with elongated cytoplasmic tails. The marrow aspirate contains similar granulated cells, including atypical bi- and multinucleated forms. On cytochemistry the neoplastic cells lack the myeloperoxidase-type reaction seen in a residual granulocyte, while their granules are highlighted by a metachromatic-type stain. The trephine biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate with strong immunohistochemical staining. Findings are consistent with mast cell leukemia, which must be distinguished from acute promyelocytic leukemia by MPO negativity, tryptase/CD117/CD25 expression and absence of PML::RARA.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei, Auer rod bundles and strong MPO positivity with PML::RARA, whereas mast cell granules are MPO negative and tryptase positive.
Basophils have lobated nuclei with water-soluble granules and are tryptase-low, CD25-negative, with no spindled or multinucleated forms and no KIT D816V.
Eosinophil granules are orange-refractile and MPO/CLAE-reactive, although PDGFRA neoplasms may also show CD25+ mast cells, requiring FISH/molecular testing.

61127.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片可見多顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富且充滿大小不一的透明空泡（泡沫狀），核小而偏位、染色質細緻、無明顯核仁，周圍為小淋巴球與成熟造血細胞，不見大量母細胞，符合化療後反應性泡沫狀組織球。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely to coarsely vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm
Small round to oval, centrally or eccentrically placed nuclei with bland chromatin and no prominent nucleoli
No wrinkled-tissue-paper, striated or sea-blue cytoplasmic texture
Background of small mature lymphocytes, occasional erythroid precursors and plasmacytoid cells
No sheets of lymphoblasts in this field
61127.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several large histiocytes with abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm and small bland nuclei lacking nucleoli. There is no crumpled-tissue-paper or sea-blue texture to suggest a storage disorder. The background contains small mature lymphocytes and scattered erythroid and other hematopoietic cells, without a conspicuous blast population in this field. Findings are consistent with reactive foamy histiocytes, in this context related to post-chemotherapy cell turnover in a patient with B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Niemann-Pick cells have uniform small soap-bubble vacuoles in marked numbers with clinical hepatosplenomegaly and lipid storage enzyme defects, not scattered reactive histiocytes after chemotherapy.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary wrinkled-tissue-paper cytoplasm rather than discrete vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green ceroid granules on Wright-Giemsa rather than clear vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear atypia and are keratin positive, unlike isolated bland CD68-positive histiocytes.

60999.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量異常前骨髓細胞（promyelocyte），核圓形、不分葉，細胞質顆粒過多但看不到 Auer 小體，部分細胞含空泡及方形結晶狀包涵體；這種「規則圓核、無柴束狀 Auer 小體」的型態提示非 PML-RARA 的變異型 RARA 轉位（ZBTB16-RARA）。
features: Sheets of large abnormal promyelocytes with round to oval, regular, non-lobulated nuclei and moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm with dense fine azurophilic hypergranulation; some cells relatively agranular
No Auer rods or faggot cells identified in the panels shown
Cytoplasmic vacuoles and discrete refractile, square-to-rectangular crystalline inclusions in occasional cells (panels E-F)
Occasional dysplastic granulocyte and small erythroid precursors in background (panel A)
60999.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grunwald-Giemsa) is dominated by large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant, heavily granulated cytoplasm and round, regular, non-lobulated nuclei. Auer rods and faggot cells are not seen. Scattered cells contain cytoplasmic vacuoles and distinctive angular crystalline inclusions, and occasional dysplastic granulocytic and erythroid precursors are present. The regular nuclear contour with hypergranulation and absent Auer rods is atypical for classic APL and, in the appropriate genetic context, is consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with a variant RARA translocation (ZBTB16-RARA).

ddx.vs: Classic APL shows bilobed/reniform nuclei and frequent faggot cells with bundles of Auer rods, whereas ZBTB16-RARA cells have regular round nuclei and lack Auer rods; confirmation requires FISH/RT-PCR.
Microgranular APL has deeply bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei with sparse visible granules and high WBC, unlike these round-nucleated hypergranular cells.
Shows a spectrum of blasts with Golgi hof and maturing neutrophils rather than a monotonous population arrested at a hypergranular promyelocyte stage.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte excess (e.g., marrow recovery after G-CSF)
ddx.vs: Recovery promyelocytes have a normal Golgi zone, orderly downstream maturation, no crystalline inclusions and no RARA rearrangement.

60807.recognize_zh: CD20 強陽性的 B 細胞呈條索或團塊狀填滿肝竇，兩側肝細胞核圓、不著色，呈現典型竇內浸潤型態，對應毛細胞白血病侵犯肝臟。
features: Strong, diffuse CD20 staining of cells packed within hepatic sinusoids
Cords and rounded aggregates conforming to sinusoidal architecture
Positive cells have round to oval nuclei with ample cytoplasm (clear halo pattern)
Unstained hepatocytes with round nuclei forming intervening plates
60807.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry on liver shows a sinusoidal infiltrate of strongly positive B cells arranged in cords and rounded aggregates between unstained hepatocyte plates. The cells are medium-sized with round to oval nuclei and abundant cytoplasm. In conjunction with CD25, CD11c and TRAP positivity, findings are consistent with hepatic involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Sinusoidal pattern is similar, but the cells are CD20 negative and CD3 positive.
Usually forms portal and nodular infiltrates in liver and lacks CD25/CD103/annexin A1/TRAP coexpression.
Also CD20+ and sinusoidal, but distinguished by lack of CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.

60615.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片在造血組織中散布數個界線清楚、淡粉紅色的上皮樣組織球聚集（箭頭），即肉芽腫；CD68 免疫染色標出肉芽腫及其中的多核巨細胞，在接種 BCG 的病人要想到 BCG 感染（BCGitis）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis containing several discrete, pale eosinophilic nodules (arrows)
Nodules composed of epithelioid histiocytes with ill-defined borders, forming non-necrotizing granulomas at this magnification
Multinucleated giant cell within a granuloma highlighted on immunostain
CD68 immunostain strongly positive in granuloma histiocytes, giant cell, and scattered background macrophages
No caseous necrosis evident in these fields
60615.describe_en: The bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) is hypercellular with maturing trilineage hematopoiesis and contains multiple small, discrete aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes forming granulomas without obvious necrosis. CD68 immunohistochemistry highlights the granulomas, including a multinucleated giant cell, and background macrophages. In a patient with prior BCG exposure (vaccination or intravesical therapy), findings are consistent with granulomatous marrow inflammation due to disseminated BCG infection; acid-fast staining, mycobacterial culture and PCR should be performed.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, so distinction requires culture/PCR speciation; TB granulomas more often show caseous necrosis.
Fungal granulomas contain yeasts visible on GMS or PAS stains rather than acid-fast bacilli.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, well-formed and non-necrotizing with negative microbiology and a compatible clinical picture.
Lymphoma-associated granulomas are accompanied by atypical CD30+ Hodgkin cells or an abnormal lymphoid infiltrate.

60679.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見體積巨大的原紅血球（giant proerythroblast，箭頭），核內有大型嗜伊紅性、類似核仁的包涵體，周圍一圈透明暈；B 圖 CD71 IHC 標出這些大細胞為紅血球系前驅細胞，是 parvovirus B19 感染的典型表現。
features: Scattered giant proerythroblasts, several times the size of surrounding precursors
Large, glassy eosinophilic intranuclear viral inclusions with peripheral chromatin margination and a clear halo ('lantern cells')
Moderate amount of amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm around the giant cells
Background marrow with myeloid cells and paucity of maturing erythroid precursors
CD71 immunostain (panel B) labels the giant cell membrane/cytoplasm, confirming erythroid lineage
60679.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, panel A) shows a cellular marrow with scattered giant proerythroblasts containing large, glassy eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo with marginated chromatin. Maturing erythroid precursors appear diminished in the background. Immunohistochemistry for CD71 (panel B) highlights the giant cell, confirming erythroid lineage. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection of erythroid precursors, explaining reticulocytopenia in the setting of autoimmune hemolytic anemia (aplastic crisis).

ddx.vs: Megaloblasts show open, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony across all erythroid stages, without glassy intranuclear inclusions or a halo.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts (≥30%) with basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm rather than scattered giant cells with viral inclusions in a marrow depleted of erythroid maturation.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters; CD71 and glycophorin positivity with CD117 negativity establish erythroid identity of these cells.
CMV causes owl-eye inclusions mainly in endothelial and stromal cells with granular cytoplasmic inclusions, whereas parvovirus affects erythroid precursors only; IHC or PCR resolves it.

60743.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的腫瘤細胞呈黏聚成團 (cohesive clusters)、細胞質豐富且核仁明顯，像漿細胞卻成群排列；切片中 CD138 呈膜染但 HepPar1 陽性，證實為肝細胞癌轉移，而非骨髓瘤。
features: Panel A: cohesive syncytial cluster of large cells with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei with small nucleoli
Panel A: cells mimic plasma cells but lack a perinuclear hof and are tightly clustered
Panel B: sheets of polygonal cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei replacing marrow between fat
Panel C: CD138 membranous staining in the tumor sheet (CD138 is not specific for plasma cells)
Panel D: HepPar1 granular cytoplasmic positivity in tumor cells, supporting hepatocellular origin
60743.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows cohesive clusters of large atypical cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei and small nucleoli, superficially resembling plasma cells. The core biopsy shows sheets of polygonal epithelioid cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm effacing the normal marrow. Immunohistochemistry shows membranous CD138 staining and granular cytoplasmic HepPar1 positivity in the tumor cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma mimicking plasma cell myeloma; CD138 positivity alone should not be taken as evidence of a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells are discohesive with a perinuclear hof and show light chain restriction and CD38/MUM1 positivity, whereas these cells form cohesive clusters and express HepPar1.

ddx.dx: Other metastatic carcinoma (e.g. renal cell carcinoma)
ddx.vs: Distinguished by IHC: HepPar1/arginase-1/glypican-3 favour hepatocellular carcinoma, PAX8 favours renal primary.
Neuroendocrine tumors show nuclear molding with salt-and-pepper chromatin and synaptophysin/chromogranin positivity rather than abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and HepPar1.

60487.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色下，大型腫瘤細胞呈強而一致的細胞膜與高基氏體（Golgi dot）點狀陽性，周圍較小的背景細胞為陰性；大細胞「均勻強 CD30」是間變性大細胞淋巴瘤的必要條件。
features: Numerous large cells with strong membranous CD30 staining
Paranuclear Golgi dot-like accentuation in many positive cells
Positive cells have large, round to irregular nuclei and abundant cytoplasm
Cohesive clusters and sheets of positive cells
Smaller background cells are CD30-negative
60487.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemical stain highlights numerous large neoplastic cells with strong, uniform membranous and paranuclear Golgi-pattern positivity, arranged in cohesive clusters and sheets. The positive cells have large irregular nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, while the intervening smaller cells are negative. Strong uniform CD30 expression in the large cell population, together with ALK positivity (see companion image), is consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive.

ddx.vs: CD30+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are scattered singly in an inflammatory background and are CD15+/PAX5 weak and ALK-negative rather than forming cohesive sheets.
CD30 in DLBCL is usually variable and the cells express CD20/PAX5, whereas ALCL cells are B-marker negative with uniform strong CD30.
PTCL-NOS may contain CD30+ cells but staining is heterogeneous and not uniformly strong in all large cells.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30+ but also keratin, OCT4 and SALL4 positive and CD45 negative.

60359.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下骨髓被中至大型、單一形態的母細胞樣細胞取代：核卵圓至不規則、染色質細緻偏空泡狀並見小核仁，細胞質淡嗜伊紅且量中等，可見核分裂，缺乏正常造血，符合 BPDCN 的母細胞形態（需免疫染色佐證）。
features: Sheets of monotonous intermediate-to-large blastoid cells effacing the marrow
Oval to irregular, occasionally folded nuclear contours
Fine to vesicular chromatin with small but distinct nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Scattered mitotic figures and interspersed small dark nuclei (residual lymphocytes/erythroid precursors or apoptotic cells)
60359.describe_en: High-power view of the H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows effacement by a monotonous population of intermediate-to-large cells arranged in diffuse sheets. The cells have oval to irregular nuclear contours, fine to vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and scant to moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, with occasional mitotic figures. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not appreciated in this field. The morphology is that of a blastic neoplasm and is nonspecific on its own; with coexpression of CD4, CD56 and CD123 by immunohistochemistry, findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: AML can look identical on H&E; MPO, lysozyme and CD14/CD163 positivity with lack of TCF4/TCL1/CD303 favors AML.
Lymphoblasts are usually smaller with scant cytoplasm and are TdT-positive with B or T lineage markers (TdT may be focally positive in BPDCN, so CD123/TCF4 are needed).

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells express CD20/PAX5 and lack CD4/CD56/CD123 coexpression.

60231.recognize_zh: 高倍下數顆母細胞（blasts）核大、染色質細緻、細胞質淡藍；旁邊多顆嗜鹼性球的深紫色顆粒粗細不均，部分顆粒脫落形成透明空泡樣小洞，並有偏粉紫的細顆粒——這種發育異常的嗜鹼性球為t(6;9) AML的特徵之一。
features: Blasts with large round to slightly indented nuclei, finely granular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm
Several abnormal basophils with coarse dark purple granules and punched-out clear vacuoles from degranulation
One basophil-lineage cell with heavily granulated cytoplasm obscuring the nucleus (left)
Fine pinkish granules in the cytoplasm of some cells, suggesting dysplastic granulation
No definite Auer rods in this field
60231.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows blasts with finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and moderate pale blue cytoplasm. Admixed basophils are dysplastic, with irregular coarse granules and clear vacuole-like spaces from partial degranulation. Definite Auer rods are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic basophilia, in keeping with AML with t(6;9)(p23;q34); DEK::NUP214.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts themselves contain sparse coarse basophilic granules and toluidine blue metachromasia, and t(6;9) and BCR::ABL1 must be absent.
Mast cells have oval central nuclei with densely packed uniform granules and are tryptase/CD117 bright and CD25 positive, whereas basophils are CD123+/CD203c+ and tryptase negative.
Blast and basophil morphology can be identical, so BCR::ABL1 detection is the discriminator.

60167.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以各階段成熟中的顆粒球（骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核）為主，多數細胞質顆粒稀少、偏淡（dysgranulopoiesis），且視野中看不到增加的單核球或嗜鹼性球，符合 BCR-ABL1 陰性的非典型 CML（aCML）。
features: Cluster of maturing granulocytic precursors: myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms predominate
Many granulocytes show pale, sparsely granulated cytoplasm (hypogranulation)
Some nuclei show irregular or hypolobated contours with coarse clumped chromatin
Single larger cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nucleus, likely an early erythroid precursor
No increase in monocytes or basophils in this field; background red cells unremarkable
60167.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a myeloid-predominant cluster composed chiefly of myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band neutrophils. Many of the maturing granulocytes have pale, hypogranular cytoplasm and some show irregular or hypolobated nuclei, indicating dysgranulopoiesis. A single early precursor with deeply basophilic cytoplasm is present. Monocytes and basophils are not increased in this field. In the appropriate clinical and genetic context (BCR-ABL1 negative, no monocytosis), findings are consistent with atypical chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: CML shows absolute basophilia and lacks significant dysgranulopoiesis, and requires demonstration of BCR-ABL1 by cytogenetics or molecular testing.
CNL has predominantly mature, well-granulated segmented neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes and no dysplasia, often with CSF3R mutation.
CMML requires persistent peripheral monocytosis (≥10% and ≥0.5–1 x10^9/L), whereas monocytes are not increased here.
Reactive states show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies rather than hypogranulation and hypolobation.

60039.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見一顆中型母細胞：核質比高、染色質細緻、僅有一圈薄薄的嗜鹼性細胞質、無 Auer 小體；背景紅血球有淚滴狀細胞（dacrocyte），在白血球低下背景下出現循環母細胞，符合 AML。
features: Single medium-sized blast about 1.5-2 times a red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly angulated nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this focus
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with several teardrop cells; platelets sparse
60039.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast of medium size with a high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a narrow rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. The red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with several teardrop forms, and platelets appear decreased. No other leukocytes are present in this field. Findings indicate circulating blasts in a cytopenic background; lineage requires flow cytometry, and in this case the findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin, unlike the fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm of this blast.
Lymphoblasts may look identical on Wright stain; MPO cytochemistry or flow cytometry is required to separate them from myeloblasts without Auer rods.
Myelofibrosis shows a leukoerythroblastic picture with prominent teardrop cells and nucleated red cells, and the marrow shows fibrosis with atypical megakaryocytes rather than 20% or more blasts.
LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and mature chromatin.

27911.recognize_zh: 超活體染色（supravital stain）下大多數紅血球含有深藍色網狀或顆粒狀物質，代表網狀紅血球明顯增加；箭頭所指的細胞則布滿均勻分布的細小藍點，呈「高爾夫球」樣，符合 HbH 包涵體（HbH inclusions），提示原診斷應修正為 α 地中海型貧血 HbH 病。
features: Majority of red cells contain dark blue precipitated reticulum in strands and clumps (marked reticulocytosis)
Arrowed red cell with numerous fine, evenly spaced blue-green dots across the whole cell ('golf ball' pattern)
Evenly distributed inclusions distinct from the coarse, irregular reticulum of reticulocytes
No large peripheral single Heinz bodies clearly identified at this resolution
Background platelets and stain precipitate
27911.describe_en: Supravital-stained blood film (brilliant cresyl blue/new methylene blue) shows a marked increase in reticulocytes, which contain coarse strands and clumps of precipitated ribosomal RNA. The arrow indicates an erythrocyte containing multiple small, uniformly distributed blue inclusions giving a 'golf ball' appearance, characteristic of precipitated hemoglobin H (beta-4 tetramers). Large peripheral Heinz bodies are not convincingly seen at this resolution. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin H inclusions, supporting a revised diagnosis of HbH disease (alpha-thalassemia) in a patient with chronic hemolysis; confirmation by hemoglobin analysis and alpha-globin gene testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Heinz bodies are one to a few larger, irregular inclusions attached to the membrane periphery, rather than many fine evenly spaced dots.
Reticulocytes show irregular filamentous or clumped reticulum that is not evenly distributed throughout the cell.
Stippling is seen on Romanowsky-stained films, whereas HbH inclusions require incubation with supravital dye to precipitate.
Pappenheimer bodies are few, clustered at the periphery and stain with Prussian blue for iron.

4103.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央有一顆有核紅血球（箭頭處）：小圓形、染色質濃縮深染、細胞質灰藍帶粉紅，旁邊有一個淡色小圓形構造；背景紅血球大小不一、以卵圓形大紅血球為主並有少數淚滴與碎片狀細胞，血小板偏少。
features: Single nucleated red blood cell with a round, dense, coarsely clumped nucleus and gray-pink cytoplasm (orthochromatic to polychromatophilic normoblast)
Small pale round body at the edge of the normoblast (arrow), possibly an adherent platelet; nature not certain at this resolution
Moderate anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, occasional teardrop-like and irregular forms
Few platelets in the field; no leukocytes other than the normoblast
No blasts, schistocyte clusters or red cell inclusions evident
4103.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate anisopoikilocytosis with numerous macro-ovalocytes, occasional teardrop-like and irregular red cells, and sparse platelets. A nucleated red blood cell with a dense, coarsely clumped nucleus and grayish-pink cytoplasm is present, with a small pale round body at its margin whose nature cannot be determined with certainty. No leukocytes, blasts or intraerythrocytic inclusions are identified in this field. In a pregnant patient with suspected acquired aplastic anemia, circulating nucleated red cells with macrocytosis and thrombocytopenia are nonspecific; bone marrow biopsy is required to establish marrow hypocellularity and exclude infiltrative or dysplastic processes.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin rim of sky-blue agranular cytoplasm and less dense chromatin, whereas this cell has hemoglobinized gray-pink cytoplasm with pyknotic chromatin.

ddx.dx: Leukoerythroblastic reaction from marrow infiltration or myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: Leukoerythroblastosis includes immature granulocytes and numerous teardrop cells, which are not prominent here.
Megaloblastic anemia also shows macro-ovalocytes and occasional normoblasts but has hypersegmented neutrophils and low B12/folate with a hypercellular marrow.
MDS shows dysplastic neutrophils (hypogranular, pseudo-Pelger) and a normo- or hypercellular dysplastic marrow rather than aplasia.

18695.recognize_zh: 這是一張教學示意圖，而非形態學影像：分三欄整理 ET 與 PV 的血栓表現，分別以腦部 CT、腫脹發紅的下肢與手掌紅斑配合條列文字，說明動脈血栓、靜脈血栓與微循環障礙（如紅斑性肢痛症 erythromelalgia）。
features: Three-panel schematic summarizing thrombotic complications of essential thrombocythemia and polycythemia vera
Arterial thrombosis panel: head CT with a hypodense territory, listing MI, unstable angina, stroke, TIA, peripheral embolism
Venous thrombosis panel: swollen erythematous limb, listing DVT, PE, splanchnic and cerebral sinus thrombosis, superficial thrombophlebitis
Microcirculatory panel: erythematous palms and fingers (erythromelalgia), listing seizures, migraine, vertigo, tinnitus, scotomas, amaurosis fugax
18695.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic educational figure summarizing the spectrum of thrombosis in essential thrombocythemia and polycythemia vera. It groups manifestations into arterial thrombosis (illustrated by a head CT with an ischemic territory), venous thrombosis including unusual sites such as splanchnic and cerebral sinus veins (illustrated by a swollen erythematous limb), and microcirculatory disturbances such as erythromelalgia (illustrated by erythematous palms). The practical point is that unexplained splanchnic vein thrombosis or erythromelalgia should prompt a blood count and JAK2 V617F/CALR testing, and that aspirin-responsive microvascular symptoms are characteristic of MPN-related thrombocytosis.

9927.recognize_zh: 這是示意圖而非形態學影像：由具自我更新能力的 LT-HSC 經 ST-HSC、MPP，分岔為骨髓系共同前驅（CMP）與淋巴系共同前驅（CLP），再往下分化成各成熟血球，並標註對應的 CFU 名稱。
features: Stem cell tier: self-renewing long-term HSC gives rise to short-term HSC and multipotent progenitor (MPP)
MPP branches into common myeloid progenitor (CMP, corresponding to CFU-GEMM) and common lymphoid progenitor (CLP)
CMP splits into megakaryocyte-erythroid progenitor (MEP, CFU-ME) and granulocyte-macrophage progenitor (GMP)
MEP yields megakaryocytes/platelets (CFU-MK) and red cells (BFU-E, CFU-E); GMP yields mast cell/basophil, eosinophil, neutrophil and monocyte/macrophage (CFU-GM)
CLP yields B, T and NK cells
9927.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic schematic of the classical hierarchical model of hematopoiesis. A self-renewing long-term hematopoietic stem cell gives rise to short-term stem cells and multipotent progenitors, which then bifurcate into common myeloid and common lymphoid progenitors. The myeloid branch divides into megakaryocyte-erythroid and granulocyte-macrophage progenitors that generate committed precursors and mature megakaryocytes/platelets, red cells, granulocytes, mast cells and monocytes, while the lymphoid branch produces B, T and NK cells. The diagram maps the in vitro colony-forming units (CFU-GEMM, CFU-ME, CFU-MK, BFU-E/CFU-E, CFU-GM) onto each progenitor stage; newer models suggest a more continuous, less strictly binary differentiation landscape.

3015.recognize_zh: 高倍切片可見大型、明顯多形性的腫瘤細胞，細胞質豐富嗜酸性、核不規則甚至呈馬蹄形並有核仁，夾雜大量凋亡小體與可見核分裂，外觀呈「anaplastic」大細胞，符合 ALCL。
features: Diffuse sheets of large, markedly pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Irregular, reniform to horseshoe-shaped vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli; occasional multinucleated forms
Numerous apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic debris, some within tumor cells or histiocytes
Mitotic figures present, including atypical forms
Discohesive to loosely cohesive growth with thin fibrovascular septa
3015.describe_en: Tissue section shows a diffuse infiltrate of large, markedly pleomorphic neoplastic cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and irregular, reniform to horseshoe-shaped vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli. Frequent apoptotic bodies, karyorrhectic debris and mitoses are present, and occasional multinucleated tumor cells are seen. No gland formation, keratinization or pigment is identified. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; confirmation requires uniform strong CD30 staining, a T-cell or null phenotype, and ALK immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is cytokeratin positive and CD30/ALK negative, while ALCL may be keratin negative but EMA positive.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, lymphocyte-depleted or syncytial
ddx.vs: Hodgkin cells are CD15+, PAX5 weak, CD45- and ALK-, often with a mixed inflammatory background.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: It expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks ALK and T-cell antigens.
These lack CD30/ALK and express mesenchymal or melanocytic markers (S100, SOX10, HMB45) instead.

3911.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒幾乎由脂肪空泡與基質網構成，只殘留少數淋巴球、漿細胞與基質細胞，看不到巨核細胞與成群造血前驅細胞，這種「空洞」的脂肪顆粒符合再生不良性貧血（aplastic anemia）。
features: Marrow particle composed predominantly of fat vacuoles with a delicate stromal network
Markedly reduced hematopoietic cells within and around the particle
Residual cells are mainly lymphocytes, plasma cells and stromal cells
No megakaryocytes and no clusters of granulocytic or erythroid precursors in this field
No abnormal infiltrate, blasts or tumor cells identified
3911.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a markedly hypocellular particle composed mainly of fat with a stromal meshwork. The few residual cells are predominantly lymphocytes, plasma cells and stromal cells, and megakaryocytes and maturing myeloid or erythroid precursors are virtually absent. No blasts or abnormal infiltrates are identified. Findings are consistent with severe marrow hypoplasia as seen in aplastic anemia; cellularity should be confirmed on trephine biopsy and hypocellular MDS, PNH and inherited marrow failure excluded.

ddx.vs: Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes or granulocytes, increased blasts or CD34-positive cells, or MDS-defining cytogenetic abnormalities, which aplastic anemia lacks.
Hypoplastic leukemia shows a clear blast population among the residual cells despite low cellularity.
A hemodilute sample lacks particles or shows cellular particles on biopsy, whereas true aplasia shows fatty particles and a hypocellular trephine.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure (e.g. Fanconi anemia, telomere disease)
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; these are separated by chromosome breakage testing, telomere length and genetic testing, and by physical stigmata or family history.

3463.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下成片細胞的卵圓核帶有明顯的縱向核溝與折疊（咖啡豆狀），胞質淡嗜酸性且邊界不清，散在嗜酸性球，是蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）的典型細胞學。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells with moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Oval to reniform nuclei with conspicuous longitudinal grooves, folds and notches (coffee-bean nuclei)
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with thin nuclear membranes and small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Scattered eosinophils with bright red granules and occasional small lymphocytes
Mild nuclear atypia without marked pleomorphism
3463.describe_en: High-power section shows diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells with moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct borders. The nuclei are oval to reniform with prominent longitudinal grooves and folds, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered eosinophils and occasional small lymphocytes are admixed. Marked pleomorphism and atypical mitoses are not seen. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation with CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Langerhans cell sarcoma has overtly malignant nuclei with prominent nucleoli, marked pleomorphism and high mitotic rate.
Rosai-Dorfman cells have round nuclei with a single nucleolus, very abundant pale cytoplasm with emperipolesis, and are CD1a-negative.
PTCL shows atypical lymphoid cells lacking grooved histiocytoid nuclei and is CD3-positive, CD1a-negative.
Mast cells have round to spindled nuclei without grooves and are tryptase/CD117 positive.

1351.recognize_zh: 這不是型態學影像，而是 von Willebrand factor（VWF）多聚體電泳圖；第 3 道頂端（箭頭處）多出比第 1、2 道更高分子量的條帶，代表出現超大型 VWF 多聚體（ultra-large VWF multimers），這是 TTP（ADAMTS13 缺乏）的特徵。
features: Agarose gel electrophoresis/immunoblot of plasma von Willebrand factor multimers, three lanes numbered 1-3
Lanes 1 and 2 show a ladder of multimer bands ending at a normal upper molecular-weight limit
Lane 3 shows additional high-molecular-weight bands extending above the normal range (arrows)
Lower-molecular-weight banding pattern is present in all three lanes
1351.describe_en: This figure is a von Willebrand factor multimer analysis rather than a morphologic image. Lanes 1 and 2 show a ladder of VWF multimers ending at the expected upper molecular-weight limit, whereas lane 3 shows additional bands of higher molecular weight beyond the top of the normal pattern (arrows), representing unusually large VWF multimers. Because ADAMTS13 normally cleaves ultra-large VWF multimers secreted by endothelial cells, their persistence in plasma indicates deficient ADAMTS13 activity. The pattern is consistent with thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura; ADAMTS13 activity and inhibitor assays are the diagnostic tests in current practice.

ddx.vs: Type 2A shows loss of high- and intermediate-molecular-weight multimers rather than an excess of ultra-large multimers.
Type 2B shows loss of the largest multimers from plasma due to enhanced platelet binding, often with thrombocytopenia, the opposite of the lane 3 pattern.
HUS has normal or only mildly reduced ADAMTS13 activity and does not typically show persistent ultra-large VWF multimers.

1415.recognize_zh: 這是血清蛋白電泳合併免疫固定電泳：SPE 在第 4 刻度處有一條窄而濃的單株帶，這條帶在 IgA 與 λ 泳道同一位置出現，IgG、IgM、κ 泳道則無對應帶，判讀為 IgA-λ 單株蛋白。
features: Serum protein electrophoresis (SPE) lane with a dense albumin band and a discrete, dense restricted band near position 4
IgA lane shows a band at the same position as the SPE restricted band
Lambda lane shows a sharp band at the same position
IgG and kappa lanes show only faint diffuse polyclonal staining without a discrete band
IgM lane shows no band
1415.describe_en: Serum protein electrophoresis with immunofixation is shown. The SPE lane shows a discrete, dense restricted band in the beta-gamma region (near position 4). On immunofixation, this band corresponds to a band in the IgA lane and a sharp band in the lambda lane at the same migration position, while the IgG and kappa lanes show only faint diffuse polyclonal staining and the IgM lane shows no band. Findings indicate an IgA lambda monoclonal protein, consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm in the appropriate clinical and marrow context.

ddx.vs: IgG kappa would show a discrete band in the IgG and kappa lanes, whereas those lanes here are diffuse and the band is in IgA and lambda.

ddx.dx: Free lambda light chain (light chain myeloma)
ddx.vs: A free light chain band appears in the lambda lane without a matching heavy-chain band, whereas here the IgA lane has a band at the same position.

ddx.dx: Beta-region protein (transferrin or C3) mimicking an M-spike
ddx.vs: Normal beta proteins are not captured by anti-immunoglobulin antisera, whereas this band fixes with both IgA and lambda.
Biclonal gammopathy would show two distinct bands in different heavy- or light-chain lanes, which is not seen here.

1287.recognize_zh: 兩顆中到大型淋巴球，細胞質淡藍、量中等，內含粗大的嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），核不規則、有摺痕或腎形，染色質細緻，符合腫瘤性 NK 細胞的大顆粒淋巴球外觀。
features: Two medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells, larger than normal large granular lymphocytes
Moderate N:C ratio with moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Irregular, indented/folded (kidney-shaped to lobulated) nuclei
Finely granular chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Coarse azurophilic cytoplasmic granules clustered on one side of the nucleus
Clean cytocentrifuge-type background without accompanying cells
1287.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation shows two isolated atypical lymphoid cells. The cells are medium to large with moderate amounts of pale blue cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules, and irregular, indented to folded nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells are larger and more nuclear-irregular than normal large granular lymphocytes. In the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context (cytoplasmic CD3+, CD56+, cytotoxic granule proteins, EBER+), findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are small, mature-appearing with round nuclei and condensed chromatin, whereas these cells are larger with irregular folded nuclei; EBER is negative in T-LGL.
Morphology overlaps substantially; separation relies on clinical presentation (systemic leukemic disease, often without a dominant nasal mass), though both are EBV-positive.
Reactive LGLs have smaller round nuclei with condensed chromatin and fine granules, and lack clonality or EBER positivity.

1223.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中散在許多單顆血小板，數量看起來偏多，大小大致正常到略大；嗜中性球與紅血球形態正常，無淚滴細胞或幼稚細胞。此單一視野無法確定血小板計數，需結合全血計數才能判讀為原發性血小板增多症。
features: Numerous scattered single platelets, apparently increased in number
Platelets of normal to mildly increased size with granular centers; no large clumps
Five mature segmented neutrophils with normal granulation and segmentation
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic without teardrop cells
No immature myeloid cells, blasts or nucleated red cells in the field
1223.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis. Platelets are dispersed singly and appear increased, with normal to slightly large forms and no clumping. Several mature segmented neutrophils with normal granulation are present, and no blasts, immature granulocytes, teardrop cells or nucleated red cells are seen. The degree of thrombocytosis cannot be quantified from this field and requires correlation with the platelet count. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular (JAK2, CALR, MPL) context.

ddx.vs: Reactive thrombocytosis has similar smear morphology; separation depends on clinical context (iron deficiency, inflammation), absence of driver mutations and marrow megakaryocyte morphology.
PMF shows teardrop cells and leukoerythroblastosis in the blood and atypical clustered megakaryocytes in marrow, which are absent here.
CML shows leukocytosis with a left shift and basophilia and is BCR::ABL1-positive, unlike this field with only mature neutrophils.

1095.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞極多，可見大量各階段成熟中的顆粒球與單核球系細胞、有核紅血球及分裂象，母細胞不多，呈現骨髓單核球增生，符合JMML的骨髓表現。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate with myelomonocytic predominance
Full spectrum of granulocytic maturation with numerous band and segmented neutrophils
Increased monocytic cells with folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm
Scattered orthochromatic normoblasts and an occasional eosinophil
Mitotic figures present; blasts not markedly increased in this field
1095.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular with a predominance of maturing granulocytic and monocytic cells. Neutrophil precursors show progressive maturation to bands and segmented forms, and there are increased monocytic cells with folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm. Erythroid precursors, an eosinophil, and mitotic figures are present, while blasts are not obviously increased. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative/myelomonocytic process such as juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic context.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML shows at least 20% blasts including promonocytes, whereas this marrow shows orderly maturation without a blast predominance.
CML shows basophilia and a myelocyte peak with BCR-ABL1, whereas JMML is BCR-ABL1-negative with monocytosis and RAS-pathway mutations.
Reactive marrow lacks clonal RAS-pathway mutations, monosomy 7, and GM-CSF hypersensitivity.

1031.recognize_zh: 緊貼骨小樑（左側粉紅色骨質）的一大片密集小淋巴球浸潤，核小而深染、部分呈不規則或有角的（cleaved）核，這種骨小樑旁（paratrabecular）分布是濾泡性淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的典型型態。
features: Dense lymphoid infiltrate abutting and spreading along the surface of a bony trabecula (paratrabecular)
Predominantly small lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular to angulated (cleaved) nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei admixed
Residual hematopoietic cells and adipocytes toward the right side of the field
1031.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate closely applied to the surface of a bony trabecula. At high power the infiltrate is composed predominantly of small lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated to cleaved hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, with occasional larger cells. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis is present away from the trabecula. Findings are consistent with involvement by a low-grade B-cell lymphoma with a paratrabecular pattern, consistent with follicular lymphoma; confirmation with CD20, CD10, BCL6 and BCL2 immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Benign aggregates are small, well circumscribed, usually non-paratrabecular and composed of round mixed T and B cells, often with a central vessel.
Mantle cell lymphoma can show paratrabecular infiltrates of irregular small cells but is CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD10 negative.
CLL/SLL typically forms nonparatrabecular nodular or interstitial infiltrates of round nuclei with proliferation centers and is CD5/CD23 positive.

4231.recognize_zh: 這張以紅血球系母細胞（深染圓核、藍灰胞質）與一顆大型細胞為主，左側幾顆紅血球上有細小紫色點狀結構，可能是瘧原蟲環狀體，但解析度下無法與血小板或染料沉澱確切區分，典型惡性瘧形態在此圖不明顯。
features: Cluster of orthochromatic and polychromatic erythroblasts with round dense nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
A larger erythroid precursor with coarse chromatin and small magenta cytoplasmic/nuclear dots (nature uncertain)
Tiny purple dot-like structures over a few red cells at left, possibly ring forms but not unequivocal
Large cell with pink-purple cytoplasm and irregular nucleus at upper right (likely macrophage or myeloid cell)
No banana-shaped gametocytes or pigmented parasites identified in this field
4231.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of maturing erythroblasts and a larger erythroid precursor, with a large cell with pink-purple cytoplasm at the upper right. A few small purple dot-like structures overlie scattered red cells and are possibly early ring forms, but they cannot be confidently distinguished from platelets or stain precipitate at this resolution, and no pigmented trophozoites or crescent gametocytes are seen. The image therefore only partially supports the diagnosis of falciparum malaria; correlation with other fields and peripheral blood thick and thin films is required.

ddx.dx: Platelets or stain precipitate overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Overlying platelets and precipitate lack a distinct blue cytoplasmic ring around a chromatin dot and are often in a different focal plane.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings and tetrads without pigment, which requires a better-preserved field with definite parasites to assess.
Erythroid hyperplasia from hemolysis or blood loss looks identical in the absence of definite intraerythrocytic parasites.

3975.recognize_zh: 低倍剛果紅（Congo red）染色中，間質與多條小血管壁（箭頭）被橘紅色（salmon-orange）的無定形沉積物包圍增厚；血管壁與間質的剛果紅陽性沉積即類澱粉，需在偏光下見到蘋果綠雙折射（apple-green birefringence）確認。
features: Salmon-orange Congo red-positive amorphous deposits throughout the interstitium
Concentric thickening of small vessel walls by orange material (arrow)
Deposits form nodular, cracked aggregates
Focal lymphocytic infiltrate at upper right
Congophilic staining alone shown; polarization not demonstrated
3975.describe_en: Congo red-stained section at low power shows extensive salmon-orange amorphous deposits within the interstitium and concentrically involving the walls of small vessels (arrow). A focal lymphocytic infiltrate is present at the periphery. Polarized light examination is not shown in this image. Findings are consistent with amyloid deposition, and in a patient with multiple myeloma support AL amyloidosis; apple-green birefringence and mass spectrometry-based typing should be documented.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific Congo red staining of collagen or elastic fibers
ddx.vs: Collagen may take up pale Congo red but lacks apple-green birefringence under polarized light.
AA amyloid is also congophilic in vessels; separation requires immunohistochemistry or mass spectrometry for serum amyloid A versus immunoglobulin light chains.
ATTR is morphologically identical on Congo red and requires amyloid typing and absence of a monoclonal protein-driven process.

3591.recognize_zh: 細胞內充滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，大小不一且蓋住細胞核，使核的分葉輪廓看不清楚；這種深色粗顆粒覆蓋核的外觀是嗜鹼球的特徵。
features: Cell about 1.5 times RBC diameter
Numerous coarse, dark purple-black granules of variable size
Granules overlie and obscure the nucleus
Bilobed/segmented nucleus only partly discernible beneath granules
Occasional clear spaces where granules have dissolved; RBCs normochromic
3591.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte of about neutrophil size packed with coarse, dark purple-black granules of variable size. The granules overlie and partly obscure the lobulated nucleus, and a few clear spaces are present where granules have washed out. Surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normal basophil.

ddx.vs: Eosinophil granules are uniform, round, and orange-red, and they do not obscure the bilobed nucleus.
Toxic granules are smaller and dark-blue and do not cover the nucleus, with Döhle bodies or vacuoles often present.
Mast cells are larger with a round, central, non-lobated nucleus and densely packed granules and are rare in blood outside mast cell neoplasms.

3655.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中有多顆中型芽細胞，染色質細緻、細胞質少量淡藍無顆粒，其中數顆核內有一塊淡染的凹陷區，像被拇指壓過（thumbprinting／cuplike 核），此特徵常見於 NPM1 或 FLT3-ITD 突變的 AML。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with fine, open chromatin
Several nuclei with a pale central invagination imparting a thumbprint (cuplike) appearance
No Auer rods or granules identified in this field
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; platelets decreased
3655.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Several blasts display a pale central nuclear invagination producing a thumbprint or cuplike appearance. No Auer rods, promyelocytes, or dysplastic granulocytes are seen, and platelets appear decreased. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cuplike blast morphology, which is associated with NPM1 mutation and FLT3-ITD; molecular testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei with fine granules and are CD34-/HLA-DR-, whereas thumbprint blasts are round with a central indentation.
Lymphoblasts are MPO-negative and may show nuclear clefts but not the central cuplike invagination; flow cytometry is required.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with folded, convoluted nuclei rather than a central pale cup.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Cells show coarser chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and a mature B- or T-cell phenotype.

3527.recognize_zh: 一個緊密重疊的細胞團，細胞邊界互相擠壓；團塊外緣的細胞帶有顆粒球系的細胞質顆粒，並與周圍散在的骨髓細胞連續過渡，傾向是造血細胞團，而非外來的上皮腫瘤細胞群。
features: Dense three-dimensional cell cluster with overlapping, molded cells and visible cell borders
Cells at the periphery of the cluster show granular cytoplasm resembling granulocytic precursors
Gradual transition between the cluster and surrounding dispersed marrow cells
Nuclear detail in the center obscured by thickness and dark staining
Background red cells and scattered maturing myeloid cells
3527.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a dense, thick cluster of overlapping cells with molded borders, surrounded by dispersed red cells and hematopoietic elements. Cells at the edge of the cluster have granular cytoplasm resembling granulocytic precursors and appear to merge with the surrounding marrow cells, favoring a clump of hematopoietic cells. Nuclear detail in the center is obscured by thickness, so a cohesive extrinsic (metastatic) cell cluster cannot be fully excluded on this image alone. Examination of the cluster edge at higher power, the trephine biopsy, and immunostains (e.g., keratin) are recommended if concern persists.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form a sharply demarcated cohesive group of cells distinctly larger than and unlike surrounding hematopoietic cells, often with nuclear pleomorphism and keratin positivity.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma forms clusters of uniform small cells with salt-and-pepper chromatin and neuropil-like fibrillary material, without admixed granulocytic cells.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear clear zone separate from the nucleus and abundant blue cytoplasm, and they lack cytoplasmic granules.

3207.recognize_zh: 低倍下見一個大腔隙的纖維性管壁，壁內數條小血管腔內可見大型深染細胞群聚（左側尤其明顯），周圍間質並無腫塊式浸潤；本倍率細胞細節有限，需高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Fibrous wall bordering a large empty lumen at low power
Small intramural vessels containing clusters of larger, hyperchromatic cells admixed with red cells
Most conspicuous intravascular aggregate in a small vessel on the left
Surrounding collagenous stroma without an extravascular mass-forming infiltrate
Magnification too low to evaluate nucleoli or chromatin detail
3207.describe_en: Low-power view shows a fibrous wall lining a large empty lumen, with small intramural vessels that contain clusters of enlarged hyperchromatic cells admixed with erythrocytes. The surrounding collagenous stroma lacks a mass-forming or sheet-like infiltrate. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, so the atypia of the intravascular cells cannot be fully assessed. The distribution is suggestive of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, best confirmed on higher power and with CD20 and CD34/CD31 immunostaining.

ddx.dx: Congested small vessels with reactive leukocytes
ddx.vs: Congested vessels contain mainly red cells with small neutrophils and lymphocytes, not aggregates of large cells with vesicular nuclei.
Carcinoma emboli are cohesive and keratin+, whereas IVLBCL cells are discohesive and CD20+.
Reactive endothelial cells line the vessel wall and are CD31+ CD34+, without free-floating atypical cells in the lumen.

3143.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量漿細胞：胞核偏位、染色質粗塊、胞質深藍色並帶核旁淡染區（hof），與嗜中性球、淋巴球混雜；在周邊血中出現這麼多漿細胞即符合漿細胞白血病。
features: Numerous plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderately abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Distinct perinuclear hof (Golgi zone) in many cells
Coarsely clumped chromatin; a few cells slightly larger with more open chromatin
Admixed neutrophils and small lymphocytes
Dense cellular area in the lower half, likely a thick or buffy-coat-like region of the smear
3143.describe_en: Smear shows a markedly increased population of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and prominent perinuclear hofs, admixed with neutrophils and small lymphocytes. Some plasma cells are slightly larger with more open chromatin. The cellular density in the lower field suggests a thick area or concentrated preparation. In a peripheral blood specimen these findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia; the absolute circulating plasma cell count or percentage (5% or more by current criteria) should be quantified and clonality confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are fewer, polytypic by flow cytometry, and often accompanied by plasmacytoid lymphocytes.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20-positive B cells and MYD88 L265P rather than a dominant plasma cell population.
Plasmablasts are larger with open chromatin and prominent central nucleoli, and the lymphoma is often EBV positive with high Ki-67.

3079.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中有成片黏著的上皮樣細胞，其周圍與間隙可見數顆胞質充滿紫色異染性顆粒的肥大細胞，並夾雜小淋巴球與分葉白血球。
features: Sheets and cords of cohesive epithelioid cells with round eccentric nuclei and vacuolated blue cytoplasm
Several mast cells with cytoplasm densely packed with purple metachromatic granules
One partially degranulated pale granular cell
Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional segmented leukocytes
Clean background
3079.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of pleural fluid shows sheets of cohesive epithelioid cells with round eccentric nuclei and vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm. Several mast cells with densely granulated purple cytoplasm are present among and adjacent to the clusters, along with one partially degranulated cell. Small lymphocytes and a few segmented leukocytes are scattered. Findings show increased mast cells in pleural fluid; the nature of the epithelioid clusters (reactive mesothelial versus metastatic carcinoma) requires immunocytochemistry.

ddx.vs: Basophils have a segmented nucleus obscured by fewer, larger granules and are smaller than mast cells.
Eosinophils have bilobed nuclei and uniform orange-pink refractile granules rather than purple metachromatic granules.
Carcinoma clusters show nuclear pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli, and epithelial markers, whereas mast cells are single, CD117 and tryptase positive.

2887.recognize_zh: 脾臟低倍 H&E：紅髓中有邊界清楚的圓形肉芽腫，中央為淡粉紅色無結構壞死區，外圍環繞呈柵欄狀排列的類上皮組織球與同心圓纖維化。
features: Well-circumscribed round granuloma with a pale eosinophilic, acellular necrotic center
Rim of palisading epithelioid histiocytes and concentric fibrosis
Second similar granuloma at right edge
Background congested red pulp and residual white pulp lymphoid tissue
2887.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of spleen shows well-circumscribed granulomas within congested red pulp. The dominant granuloma has a pale, homogeneous eosinophilic necrotic center surrounded by palisading epithelioid histiocytes and a concentric fibrous rim; a second similar lesion is present at the edge of the field. Residual white pulp is seen nearby. Findings are consistent with necrotizing (caseating) granulomatous inflammation; special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi and cultures are recommended.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas are typically non-necrotizing, small and confluent, without central caseous necrosis.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells (CD30+, CD15+) within a mixed inflammatory background rather than pure palisading granulomas.
Infarcts are wedge-shaped with ghost outlines of red pulp architecture and lack a palisading epithelioid histiocyte rim.

2823.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片極度富含細胞，以各階段顆粒球（骨髓細胞、帶狀及分葉核中性球）為主，夾雜嗜酸性與深紫色嗜鹼性顆粒球，母細胞不多，符合慢性期 CML 的顆粒球增生。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic lineage
Full spectrum of maturation with myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils predominating
Scattered basophils with dark purple granules and eosinophils
Blasts are not increased in this field
Erythroid precursors relatively inconspicuous (high M:E ratio)
2823.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular with marked granulocytic hyperplasia showing orderly maturation, with myelocytes and mature neutrophils predominating. Basophils and eosinophils are increased and scattered throughout. Blasts are not increased in this field and erythroid precursors are relatively sparse, indicating an elevated M:E ratio. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase; confirmation of BCR::ABL1 is required.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia lacks basophilia and eosinophilia, shows toxic changes and is BCR::ABL1-negative.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis without basophilia and is BCR::ABL1-negative, often with SETBP1/ASXL1 mutations.
CNL is dominated by mature segmented neutrophils with few immature forms, no basophilia and a CSF3R mutation.
Advanced phase requires increased blasts (10-19% or >=20%), basophils >=20% or additional clonal abnormalities, not seen in this field.

2695.recognize_zh: 視野中四顆嗜中性球的核都沒有正常分成 3–5 葉，而是橢圓、花生形或圓形，染色質非常濃縮成塊，細胞質顆粒正常；多顆同時出現低分葉，符合 Pelger-Huët 異常。
features: Multiple neutrophils of normal size with hyposegmented nuclei
Nuclei oval, peanut-shaped or round (non-segmented), without well-formed lobes
Coarsely clumped, very condensed chromatin indicating nuclear maturity
Pale pink cytoplasm with normal fine granulation
Normochromic red cells with occasional polychromatic cells
2695.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several neutrophils, all of which display hyposegmented nuclei that are oval, peanut-shaped or round. The nuclear chromatin is coarsely clumped and mature, and the cytoplasm shows normal granulation without hypogranularity. Red cells are largely normochromic with occasional polychromatic cells. Findings are consistent with Pelger-Huët anomaly; review of the entire neutrophil population and family history is needed to separate the inherited anomaly from acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huët change.

ddx.vs: Acquired change usually affects only a subset of neutrophils and is often accompanied by cytoplasmic hypogranularity and other dysplastic or cytopenic features.
Band forms have horseshoe-shaped, non-constricted nuclei with less clumped chromatin rather than compact round or bilobed dense nuclei.
Metamyelocytes have kidney-shaped nuclei with finer chromatin and appear alongside other immature granulocytes.

2631.recognize_zh: 高倍鐵染色中多顆紅母細胞的核周圍排列著一圈藍色粗鐵顆粒，部分幾乎完整環繞細胞核，旁邊的大型早期細胞沒有鐵顆粒，是教科書型的環狀鐵粒母細胞。
features: Prussian blue stain with red nuclear counterstain at high power
Several erythroid precursors with coarse blue-green granules forming a perinuclear ring around at least one-third of the nucleus
Iron-containing cells show condensed, clumped chromatin of intermediate to late normoblasts
Larger cells with finer chromatin (early precursors) lack siderotic granules
Small extracellular iron aggregate and occasional background granules
2631.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue shows several intermediate to late erythroid precursors in which coarse blue-green siderotic granules form a collar around the nucleus, in some cells encircling most of the nuclear circumference. These are classic ring sideroblasts. Larger early precursors with finer chromatin do not contain stainable iron, and a small extracellular iron aggregate is present. Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts; quantification relative to erythroid precursors, blast enumeration and SF3B1 mutation testing are needed to classify myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts have sparse fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm, not a perinuclear ring of coarse granules.

ddx.dx: Pappenheimer bodies in circulating red cells
ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are iron granules in anucleate red cells at the cell periphery, whereas ring sideroblasts are nucleated precursors with perinuclear mitochondrial iron.

ddx.dx: Secondary sideroblastic anemia from alcohol or drugs
ddx.vs: These cause identical ring sideroblasts, so clinical history and molecular studies for clonality are required.

2567.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的骨髓顆粒（particle）幾乎由脂肪空泡與細網狀基質組成，造血細胞稀疏，顯示骨髓細胞量明顯減少（hypocellular particle）。
features: Low-power view of a marrow particle composed predominantly of fat vacuoles
Thin, dark-staining stromal strands forming a lacy network between fat spaces
Sparse hematopoietic cells scattered along the stroma
No sheets of blasts or abnormal cellular aggregates identified at this magnification
Individual cell morphology and dysplasia cannot be assessed at this power
2567.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a particle composed predominantly of adipocytes with a delicate stromal network and only scattered hematopoietic cells, indicating markedly decreased particle cellularity. Cytologic detail and dysplasia cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Hypocellularity should be confirmed on the core biopsy. In a patient with cytopenias and documented dysplasia or MDS-defining cytogenetics, findings are consistent with hypocellular myelodysplastic syndrome.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows similarly fatty particles, so separation depends on absence of dysplasia, blasts and MDS-defining cytogenetic abnormalities on high-power review and karyotype.
A hemodilute specimen has few or no particles and a peripheral-blood-like cell population, whereas here a true particle is present and is itself fatty.
Age-appropriate or therapy-induced hypocellularity lacks persistent dysplasia and clonal abnormalities and correlates with age and treatment history.

2503.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片細胞量高，大量含橘紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞（嗜酸性骨髓球、後骨髓球）遍布視野，嗜酸性系明顯增加，符合嗜酸性球增多症候群的骨髓表現。
features: Cellular aspirate with marked increase in eosinophilic lineage cells
Mature eosinophils and eosinophilic myelocytes/metamyelocytes with orange-red granules
Larger immature cells with round nuclei and granular cytoplasm (early eosinophil precursors)
Scattered erythroid precursors with dense nuclei and occasional granulocytes
Free granules in the background from disrupted cells; no obvious blast excess at this power
2503.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows a cellular specimen with a striking increase in eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors at all stages of maturation, containing orange-red granules, together with scattered erythroid precursors and neutrophils. Free granules from disrupted cells are present in the background. A significant increase in blasts is not evident at this magnification. Findings show marked marrow eosinophilia; idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome is a diagnosis of exclusion requiring evaluation for reactive causes, PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangements, clonal cytogenetics and a T-cell clone.

ddx.vs: FIP1L1-PDGFRA neoplasms can look identical but often show increased spindled mast cells and elevated tryptase, requiring FISH/RT-PCR.
CEL requires a clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormality or increased blasts (2-19% PB or 5-19% BM), which morphology alone cannot establish.
Reactive eosinophilia shows orderly maturation and resolves with treatment of the cause, identified by clinical and laboratory work-up.
AML with inv(16) has increased blasts and monocytes with abnormal eosinophils containing large basophilic-purple granules.

2375.recognize_zh: 單獨一顆漿細胞的細胞質完全被大量藍紫色圓球狀 Russell bodies 撐大，外觀像一串葡萄，偏位的核被擠到一邊，是 Mott cell（葡萄細胞）的經典圖像。
features: Single plasma cell distended by innumerable round, uniform blue-violet globules (Russell bodies)
Grape-cluster (Mott cell) appearance with globules extending beyond the apparent cell border
Eccentric, irregular nucleus with clumped chromatin displaced to one side
Adjacent neutrophil and a small lymphocyte for size comparison
Clean background with scattered platelets
2375.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single plasma cell whose cytoplasm is expanded by innumerable round, uniform blue-violet globules, producing a grape-cluster appearance consistent with a Mott cell containing Russell bodies. The nucleus is eccentric with clumped chromatin and is displaced by the inclusions. A neutrophil and a small lymphocyte are nearby for size comparison. Findings are consistent with a Mott cell; this change is nonspecific and may occur in reactive plasmacytosis or plasma cell neoplasms, so clonality and plasma cell burden should be evaluated.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are smaller, dark purple-black, water-soluble and overlie a segmented nucleus, not large blue globules around a plasma cell nucleus.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm with a small eccentric nucleus rather than discrete round globules.
Dutcher bodies are intranuclear pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus, whereas Russell bodies are cytoplasmic globules.

2183.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見單調的小到中型淋巴細胞成片排列，核圓形或輕度不規則（centrocyte-like），細胞質淡染量中等，呈現邊緣帶 B 細胞/單核球樣（monocytoid）外觀，缺乏大型轉化細胞，符合肺部 MALT 淋巴瘤的細胞學。
features: Sheets of monotonous small to intermediate-sized lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular (centrocyte-like) nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm giving a monocytoid appearance
Only rare larger cells; no sheets of large transformed cells
Thin fibrous septa and eosinophilic stromal/epithelial-like area at right edge
2183.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows sheets of monotonous small to intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm, consistent with marginal zone (monocytoid/centrocyte-like) B cells. Large transformed cells are rare, and sheets of large cells are not seen. Lymphoepithelial lesions and plasmacytic differentiation are not clearly demonstrated in this field. The findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT type in the context of a lung lesion, to be supported by immunophenotype and clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous with germinal centers and polytypic plasma cells, lacking the monotonous monocytoid B-cell sheets and light-chain restriction.
MCL cells have scant cytoplasm and are cyclin D1+/SOX11+/CD5+, whereas MALT lymphoma cells have more pale cytoplasm and are CD5-/cyclin D1-.
FL shows neoplastic follicles of centrocytes/centroblasts with CD10/BCL6 and BCL2 co-expression, unlike CD10-negative marginal zone cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising from MALT lymphoma
ddx.vs: Transformation requires solid sheets of large cells, which are not present in this field.

2119.recognize_zh: 油鏡下中央有一個圓形血小板，大小接近鄰近紅血球的一半以上，遠大於上方三個正常大小的血小板，內含紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（granulomere）與淡藍色外周（hyalomere），無細胞核，即為巨大血小板（giant platelet）。
features: Single round anucleate platelet approaching red cell size, far larger than adjacent normal platelets
Abundant purple azurophilic granules distributed through the center (granulomere)
Pale blue peripheral hyalomere without a nucleus
Three normal-sized platelets nearby for size comparison
Surrounding red cells unremarkable at this magnification
2119.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a round, anucleate giant platelet approaching the size of the adjacent red cells, containing abundant purple azurophilic granules with a pale blue hyalomere. Three normal-sized platelets nearby provide a size reference. No nucleus is present, excluding a small lymphocyte or micromegakaryocyte. Giant platelets such as this are commonly seen in myeloproliferative neoplasms including chronic myeloid leukemia, and also in inherited macrothrombocytopenias and states of increased platelet turnover.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a nucleus occupying most of the cell, whereas this cell is anucleate with granules throughout.
Micromegakaryocytes contain a dense nucleus, which is absent in this platelet.
Basophils are nucleated with coarse dark granules overlying a nucleus.
Morphology is identical; MYH9 disorders show Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions and Bernard-Soulier lacks GPIb-IX-V on flow cytometry.

1991.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內可見大片淡染的大細胞區，與左下角殘存的小淋巴球區交錯；大細胞呈強弱不一的細胞膜陽性（圖型提示 CD30），右下角為被膜與結締組織。
features: Lymph node with large pale-staining atypical cells forming sheets and clusters in the upper field
Variable membranous positivity in the large cells, strong in scattered cells and clusters, weak in many
Interspersed bands of small, negative lymphocytes, with a residual small-lymphocyte area at lower left
Capsule and perinodal fibrous tissue at lower right
1991.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (antibody not labeled; pattern suggests CD30) of a lymph node shows partial effacement by sheets and clusters of large, pale atypical cells with variable membranous positivity, ranging from weak to strong. Residual areas of small negative lymphocytes are present, particularly at the lower left, and the capsule is seen at the lower right. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. With a B-cell immunophenotype, findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant.

ddx.vs: ALCL typically shows strong, uniform CD30 in essentially all tumor cells, often with a sinusoidal pattern, and lacks B-cell markers.
cHL shows only scattered CD30-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than confluent sheets of large cells.
Reactive immunoblasts are CD30-positive but are admixed with a spectrum of plasmacytoid cells and preserve nodal architecture without sheets of atypical cells.

1799.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中大部分紅血球表面帶有多個長短不一、分布不規則的尖刺突起且多數缺乏中央淡染區（箭頭），是棘狀紅血球（spur cell, acanthocyte）大量出現的表現。
features: Numerous red cells with multiple irregularly spaced spiculated projections of variable length (arrows)
Many spiculated cells are dense and lack central pallor
Admixture of cells with shorter, more regular crenation and some normal-appearing discocytes
Mild anisocytosis
Occasional leukocytes including a lymphocyte and a neutrophil; low-power view limits fine detail
1799.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a large proportion of red cells bearing multiple irregular, unevenly distributed spicules of variable length (arrows), many of which are dense and lack central pallor. Some cells show more regular crenation and others appear normal. White cells are unremarkable in this field. Fine assessment of spicule shape is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with numerous acanthocytes (spur cells), as seen in spur cell anemia of advanced liver disease.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced, uniform projections with preserved central pallor, and artifactual crenation is patchy in thick or slowly dried areas.
These produce similar acanthocytes, so separation depends on clinical context and lipid profile rather than morphology.
Hyposplenism shows occasional acanthocytes together with Howell-Jolly bodies and target cells rather than a predominant acanthocyte population.
